releases.title: Horizon Commerce and Pacvue Expand Strategic Partnership to Connect Retail Media Planning, Activation and Measurement
releases.body:
Expanded partnership brings together Horizon Commerce's strategy and activation expertise with Pacvue's Commerce Media Operating System to help marketers move from insight to outcomes faster

NEW YORK, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Horizon Commerce, Horizon Media Holdings' specialist agency for commerce and digital experience, and Pacvue, the leading AI-Powered Commerce Media Operating System, today announced an expanded strategic partnership designed to help advertisers more effectively connect retail media planning, activation and measurement. The expanded relationship brings Horizon Commerce's Strategy and Activation teams, including its Blu Commerce intelligence capabilities, closer to Pacvue's Commerce Media Operating System, enabling a more integrated workflow across planning, activation and measurement on major retail media platforms.

The partnership addresses a persistent challenge for marketers: the systems used to measure media performance and determine investment strategy are often disconnected from the platforms used by teams to execute campaigns. As a result, marketers can identify an opportunity through measurement but are forced to rely on manual processes, separate taxonomies and retailer-specific metrics to translate that insight into action.

Blu Commerce provides a standardized view of retail media performance across retailers, products and media tactics, including measurement of incremental contribution and iROI. Pacvue unifies that intelligence with other proprietary omnicommerce signals to power media activation, giving Horizon Commerce's Strategy and Activation teams one platform to translate those insights into investment decisions and activation strategies across major retail media networks.

Blu Commerce and Pacvue's technology works in lockstep, feeding performance back into the next cycle of planning and optimization. Pacvue's real-time commerce signals – including availability, pricing, and content health – keep activation aligned with what's happening on the digital shelf. The result is a common decision framework connecting senior marketing leadership and campaign practitioners, helping brands allocate investment more effectively, reduce inefficient spend and drive greater incremental sales.

"Retail media has no shortage of data. The harder problem is turning that data into a consistent investment decision," said Katie Comerford, President of Horizon Commerce. "A brand may be operating across Amazon, Walmart, Target and other retailers, each with different attribution methodologies, reporting structures and optimization environments. Blu Commerce was built to create a common economic view across those investments. By bringing that intelligence into a workflow that connects our Commerce Strategy and Activation teams with Pacvue, we can shorten the distance between understanding what is driving incremental growth and doing something about it."

This connected approach is already delivering results. When Revlon's Mitchum brands needed to close the gap between retail media and commerce operations on Amazon, Horizon Commerce unified its internal platforms with Pacvue's advertising and commerce signals. The results included a 13% average weekly revenue lift, a 19-point improvement in Best Seller Rank (BSR), a 5% lift in paid search revenue, and a 3% lift in paid search conversion rate. By aligning media investment with commerce signals, Revlon and Horizon Commerce shifted from reactive adjustments to proactive growth, powered by automation, actionable insights, and the integrated capabilities of Pacvue's Commerce Operating System.

"Horizon Commerce has been a valued partner since 2022, and this expansion reflects how that relationship has grown," said Melissa Burdick, Co-founder and President of Pacvue. "With more touchpoints across the customer journey than ever, measurement and activation must keep pace with how complex investment decisions have become. Pacvue empowers agency teams with the insight and activation to execute faster, while preserving the flexibility to evaluate performance against the business outcomes that matter to each brand."

The partnership reflects Horizon's broader approach to commerce technology: building an open intelligence layer that connects data, decisioning and activation rather than requiring marketers to operate within a closed technology ecosystem. Together, Horizon Commerce and Pacvue are creating a more connected commerce investment workflow, combining Blu Commerce's cross-retailer measurement, iROI, scenario planning and investment intelligence with scaled activation through Pacvue. The result is a clearer path to shifting dollars toward the highest-value opportunities, reducing inefficient spend and driving greater incremental sales.

ABOUT HORIZON COMMERCE

Horizon Commerce is Horizon Media Holdings' commerce and digital experience agency, helping brands connect media, commerce, data, and technology to drive measurable growth. As a fiercely independent growth partner, the agency combines human expertise, open technology ecosystems, and transparent intelligence to help brands make better investment decisions and create more connected customer experiences across DTC, retail, marketplaces, social, and omnichannel environments. 

At the center of its offering is Blu Commerce, Horizon Commerce's proprietary commerce intelligence platform, which creates a standardized view of performance across retailers, products, and media tactics. Blu Commerce connects measurement, scenario planning, forecasting, and optimization to help marketers understand what is driving incremental growth, identify future investment opportunities, and move from insight to action faster.

ABOUT PACVUE

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry-leading AI and real-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China. Combined with Helium 10's SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry's most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes. Founded in 2018, Pacvue spans Seattle, Los Angeles, Chicago, New York, Washington D.C., London, Shanghai, and Tokyo. Discover more at pacvue.com.

releases.title: CACI Launches Good Dogs for Great Americans to Help Veterans Regain Independence Through Custom-Trained Service Dogs
releases.body:
New partnership with the Washington Capitals and America's VetDogs turns every Capitals blocked shot into funding to train and place service dogs

RESTON, Va., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CACI International Inc. (NYSE: CACI) today announced the launch of Good Dogs for Great Americans, the company's signature philanthropy program dedicated to helping veterans regain independence through specially trained service dogs. In partnership with the Washington Capitals and America's VetDogs, the program turns defense on the ice into life-changing support for those who defended our nation.

As the ambassador for Good Dogs for Great Americans, Lt. Gen. (Ret.) Mike Shields, CACI Senior Vice President, brings more than three decades of Army leadership and a commitment to serving America's veterans.

"Throughout my Army career, I learned that no one succeeds alone. We rely on trusted teammates to overcome obstacles and accomplish the mission," said Shields. "For many veterans, a specially trained service dog becomes that trusted partner. The dogs provide greater independence, renewed confidence, reduced anxiety, and unwavering support every day. I'm proud to help champion CACI's Good Dogs for Great Americans because this organization allows more veterans the opportunity to experience that profound partnership and improved quality of life."

The program comes to life through CACI On Defense, CACI's season-long activation with the Washington Capitals. Throughout the NHL season, CACI will donate $250 to America's VetDogs for every Capitals blocked shot. Those donations will help train and place service dogs with veterans living with physical disabilities, post-traumatic stress, hearing and vision loss, and other challenges. Based on the team's average of approximately 1,300 blocked shots each season, the partnership is expected to fund training for up to eight service dogs annually.

Service dogs trained by America's VetDogs help veterans and first responders navigate everyday life, increase mobility, independence, and improve overall well-being. Each placement helps individuals regain confidence while strengthening their connection to their communities.

"We are incredibly proud to partner with CACI in support of our mission to provide life-changing service dogs to veterans with disabilities," said John Miller, president and CEO of America's VetDogs. "A service dog can restore confidence, independence and dignity, empowering a veteran to navigate everyday life with greater freedom. CACI's partnership will help us expand that impact and reach more veterans who can benefit from these extraordinary partnerships. We are grateful for their commitment to those who have served and for helping ensure more veterans have access to the support they deserve, at no cost to them."

"We're thrilled to partner with CACI through the CACI On Defense Program. CACI has been an outstanding partner to the Capitals, and this platform reflects a shared commitment to honoring and supporting our nation's veterans. It gives us a meaningful way to support the veteran community that means so much to the Capitals and our fans, and we're excited to build on this partnership and create lasting impact for years to come," said Patrick Duffy, Chief Partnership Officer at Monumental Sports & Entertainment.

Throughout the season, fans will experience CACI On Defense through in-arena features, broadcast integrations, social media, and community storytelling, highlighting how every blocked shot helps change veterans' lives.

About CACI

CACI International Inc (NYSE: CACI) is a technology-first national security company that expands the limits of national security through innovation, discipline, and operational excellence. We deliver advanced technologies that help our customers move faster, operate more efficiently, and anticipate and defeat evolving threats. Our 27,000 talented employees and strong culture drive our success and have earned CACI recognition as a Fortune World's Most Admired Company. CACI is a member of the Fortune 500™, the Russell 1000 Index, and the S&P MidCap 400 Index. For more information, visit caci.com.

About Monumental Sports & Entertainment

Monumental Sports & Entertainment (MSE) is one of the leading integrated sports and entertainment companies globally. MSE's portfolio spans premier professional sports teams, world-class venues, and next-generation media properties, with marquee assets including the NHL's Washington Capitals, NBA's Washington Wizards, WNBA's Washington Mystics, NBA G League's Capital City Go-Go, Capital One Arena, and Monumental Sports Network, along with an investment in Team Liquid.

Rooted in the nation's capital, MSE brings Washington, D.C.'s distinct influence, ambition, and leadership to the global sports and entertainment landscape. The company harnesses the power of its platform to drive continuous innovation and deliver extraordinary experiences that inspire and unite our community, our fans, and our people. For additional information on MSE, please visit monumentalsports.com.

About America's VetDogs

For more than 20 years, America's VetDogs (www.VetDogs.org) has trained and placed guide and service dogs to provide independence, enhanced mobility, and companionship to veterans with disabilities from all eras. In 2015, America's VetDogs opened its programs to first responders, including fire, police, and emergency medical personnel. America's VetDogs is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit organization founded by the Guide Dog Foundation (est. 1946) and serves our country's and communities' heroes in all 50 states, Washington, DC. Puerto Rico, and beyond. America's VetDogs relies on contributions from generous individuals, corporations, service clubs, and foundations to fund its mission to help those who have served our country live with dignity and independence. It costs more than $50,000 to breed, raise, train, and place one assistance dog, but America's VetDogs provides its services completely free of charge to the individual. America's VetDogs has been accredited by both the International Guide Dog Federation and Assistance Dogs International. Apply, volunteer, and donate at VetDogs.org.

releases.title: Introducing Outpost Space Factories: Orbital Manufacturing as a Service Unlocking Commercial Scale Production
releases.body:
With "Space Factories," Outpost offers standardized, modular manufacturing infrastructure as a service; and will manufacture its own StarFiber optical fiber as the first product off the line

LOS ANGELES and PLAYA VISTA, Calif. , Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Outpost Technologies Corporation today introduced Space Factories, a program that lets companies manufacture products in orbit and return them to Earth without building a space program of their own. Instead of developing a bespoke spacecraft, reentry system, and recovery operation for a single mission, companies bring their manufacturing process to Outpost's standardized, reusable platform; turning space manufacturing into standardized infrastructure they can specify rather than design and build.

With "Space Factories," Outpost offers standardized, modular manufacturing infrastructure as a service

A growing list of high-value products from specialty optical fibers to pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and advanced crystals can be made better, or only, in microgravity. To date, every attempt to produce them in orbit has been a one-of-a-kind effort, with each company re-solving the same problems of power, thermal control, containment, safety, and return from scratch. Space Factories lets customers focus on what they do best, developing high-value products, while Outpost provides a common industrial platform: standardized modules that reduce bespoke engineering, shorten development timelines, and allow far more rapid deployment.

Just as important is what happens after production. Making a product in orbit is only valuable if it can be brought home frequently, reliably and at scale. Bringing things back from orbit is Outpost's core capability, which makes the company uniquely positioned to close the loop from orbital manufacturing to recovered product on the ground.

"No company should have to become a spacecraft company just to find out whether their product is better when it's made in space," said Amir Blachman, President and co-founder of Outpost. "We're designing and building the hard, expensive infrastructure: the vehicle, the power and thermal systems, standardized manufacturing modules, the reentry and recovery; and we operate it as a service."

Proving it with StarFiber

Outpost is putting the platform to work, manufacturing its own high-value products in orbit. StarFiber, the company's next-generation metal fluoride optical fiber, will be produced in a Space Factory module. Metal fluoride fibers can achieve dramatically lower signal loss than the silica fibers that carry today's data and telecommunications traffic, but they are extremely difficult to manufacture at quality on Earth, where gravity introduces defects during production. Microgravity offers a path to producing them at the quality their performance promises. StarFiber's formulation is also radiation-hardened, making it well suited to satellite, defense, and other demanding environments (and it will demonstrate the full Space Factory model end to end, from orbital production to recovered product on the ground).

"StarFiber is how we prove the platform on ourselves before we ask anyone else to fly on it," said Ryan Reel, VP of Commercial Partnerships and Product Strategy at Outpost. "It's the same infrastructure, the same modules, and the same return path we're offering to every customer. Any company developing a product that benefits from microgravity can plug into a platform we've already flown and get to orbit far faster and for less cost than they could on their own."

One platform, not a bespoke factory for every customer

Space Factories is built on a modular architecture that keeps the expensive, complex systems common and reusable, while confining customization to the smallest possible layer. Outpost's reusable free-flying spacecraft, CarryAll, provides the standardized foundation: orbital transport, power, communications, and the systems for Earth return and recovery. A separable CarryAll Space Factory container houses the customer's payload, manages production, pressurization, thermal, data, and safety interfaces. Only the innermost manufacturing module is tailored to a customer's specific process.

By using a common spacecraft, recovery infrastructure, software, and much of the manufacturing components across every mission, customers avoid the cost, risk, and delay of engineering a full system for a single flight. Proven modules can be replicated across missions or scaled in capacity as demand grows. Recovered equipment can be inspected, refurbished, and reflown: forming the foundation of commercial-scale production.

An open invitation

Space Factories is designed as a shared platform, and Outpost is opening it to industry. Companies developing products that benefit from manufacturing in space in optical materials, pharmaceuticals and biotech, semiconductors, crystal growth, and beyond can build and fly with Outpost. To learn more or discuss a manufacturing module, contact sales@outpost.space.

About Outpost Technologies Corporation

Outpost is building reusable Earth-return vehicles that close one of the most important gaps in the space economy: the ability to move meaningful quantities of cargo back from orbit with precision, speed, and repeatability.

Launch capacity has advanced rapidly, but Earth-return capacity remains limited. Outpost is building the southbound logistics layer required to support national security, in-space manufacturing, orbital warehousing, scientific research, and critical logistics. The CarryAll vehicle family is intended to scale from early payload-return missions to large-mass cargo operations, with precision delivery and large-mass capacity serving as the company's defining differentiation. For more information visit: www.outpost.space

releases.title: Free Press Alive and Well as RAV Provides Free Live Feed of Trump White House Coverage to All Media Outlets
releases.body:
WEST PALM BEACH, Fla., Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Real America's Voice (RAV) today announced that its White House and presidential pool coverage, captured by RAV's internal camera teams, will be made broadly and freely available to media organizations everywhere.

"At a time when a handful of legacy outlets are casting the President's decision as the death of the free press, the reality is exactly the opposite," said Parker Sigg, Vice President of Real America's Voice at Performance One Media. "Real America's Voice is pleased to provide a feed of the pool camera to all the media, even the fake news, and to the American people. A free press is alive and well, and we are honored to be a conduit of this foundational constitutional principle for all of America."

RAV is making its pool coverage available through three channels:

A clean, public feed. Unwatermarked video from the White House and presidential pool will be published publicly on RAV's official YouTube channel, (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rswk5YjG-3g) where any media organization — national, local, or independent — can access and utilize the footage.

Direct professional delivery. Networks and outlets requiring the feed delivered directly can receive it through professional distribution and ingest methods, coordinated to their technical requirements.

A single point of contact. All media organizations interested in receiving the pool feed should contact pool@americasvoice.news, where RAV's team will coordinate the appropriate technical delivery method.

Contrary to the claims and assumptions currently circulating about access to and availability of this coverage, RAV's position is unambiguous: this is coverage of the presidency, produced in the public interest, and it will be distributed as widely as possible.

You can watch all Real America's Voice Programming at https://realamericasvoice.com or by downloading the app on Apple or Android. Real America's Voice is also available on DISH Network, Prime Video, Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV, Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus, and Roku.

releases.title: FAN EXPO, the World's Largest Comic Con Producer, Selects Showpass as Its Official Ticketing and Event Technology Partner
releases.body:
The selection brings ticketing, fan experiences, and event operations onto a single platform across FAN EXPO's portfolio of events, which welcomes more than one million fans annually.

CALGARY, AB, Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Showpass today announced that it has been selected as the official ticketing and event technology partner for FAN EXPO, the world's largest comic con producer. Showpass will power ticketing, fan engagement, and event operations across FAN EXPO's portfolio of industry-leading events, including FAN EXPO Canada, FAN EXPO Boston, FAN EXPO Dallas, MEGACON Orlando, CALGARY EXPO, FAN EXPO Denver, FAN EXPO Chicago, and many more.

Spanning 13 cities across North America, FAN EXPO's events bring together fans of comics, gaming, anime, horror, sci-fi, cosplay, entertainment and everything in between. From the nearly 200,000 attendees who gather annually at MEGACON Orlando to the hundreds of thousands more attending FAN EXPO events throughout North America, FAN EXPO has built one of the most recognized and influential portfolios in live entertainment.

Across FAN EXPO's North American portfolio, Showpass will provide the technology and operational infrastructure needed to support high-demand on-sales, large-scale fan experiences, and complex event operations.

Fans will benefit from a seamless purchasing experience directly through FAN EXPO channels, allowing them to purchase tickets, photo opportunities, autographs, premium experiences, merchandise, and event add-ons through a single transaction. The collaboration will also provide a fully branded FAN EXPO purchasing journey, RFID capabilities, advanced event operations technology, and the scalability required to support some of the largest fandom events in the world.

"FAN EXPO has built one of the most impressive event portfolios in live entertainment," said Lucas McCarthy, Founder and CEO of Showpass. "Supporting events of this scale requires more than ticketing. It requires a platform capable of powering the entire event operation. Whether a fan is purchasing a badge or securing a photo opportunity with a favourite celebrity, every interaction should feel effortless. We're proud to provide FAN EXPO with one connected system to manage its events and deliver world-class fan experiences across North America."

FAN EXPO Vice President Andrew Moyes said, "As our events continue to grow, we're focused on ensuring the fan experience evolves alongside them. Showpass brings the innovation, technology, flexibility, and operational expertise needed to support that growth while helping us create an even better experience for our fans."

FAN EXPO's selection of Showpass represents another milestone in Showpass's work across entertainment, sports, festivals, conventions, and cultural events throughout North America. Trusted by organizers to power everything from community events to some of the continent's most attended live experiences, Showpass connects ticketing, marketing, operations, analytics, and fan engagement through a single platform designed to give organizers greater control over their events.

ABOUT SHOWPASS:

Showpass is the operating system for independent live events, connecting every stage of the event lifecycle into one platform. From ticketing and marketing to operations, analytics, and financing, Showpass gives organizers one system to run, grow, and own their events. More than 175 million tickets have been issued through Showpass, powering music, sports, festivals, venues, cultural events, and everyday things to do across North America. Built with a mission to reignite the joy of live experiences, Showpass equips organizers with the tools and support needed to elevate the fan experience. Independently owned, Showpass is one of North America's fastest-growing event technology companies, recognized by Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 and named to The Globe and Mail's Canada's Top Growing Companies list for three consecutive years.

ABOUT FAN EXPO:

With over a million fans and counting, FAN EXPO HQ attracts pop culture enthusiasts, locally and internationally, to come together to celebrate all things fandom. Collectively it hosts over one million fans annually at FAN EXPO Dallas, FAN EXPO Canada, MEGACON Orlando, FAN EXPO Boston, FAN EXPO Denver, CALGARY EXPO, FAN EXPO Chicago, FAN EXPO Philadelphia, FAN EXPO Portland, FAN EXPO New Orleans, FAN EXPO Cleveland, FAN EXPO Vancouver, Toronto Comicon, Dallas FAN FESTIVAL, and EDMONTON EXPO. The latest schedule of events is available here on their website, along with up-to-date ticket information. Discover. Celebrate. Belong.

releases.title: HEARST MEDIA PRODUCTION GROUP EXPANDS LUCKY DOG FRANCHISE WITH NEW SERIES LUCKY DOG: PAWS WITH PURPOSE, PREMIERING OCTOBER 3 ON CBS
releases.body:
New Series Will Lead a Full Hour of Lucky Dog Programming

Watch Trailer

NEW YORK, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG) today announced its new series Lucky Dog: Paws with Purpose will debut Saturday, October 3 on CBS. Produced by HMPG in an exclusive partnership with USAA, the leading financial services company for the military, veterans and their families, it will air weekend mornings on CBS as part of the "CBS WKND" educational/informational (E/I) programming block (times may vary; check local listings).

Hosted by Emmy® Award-winning animal trainer Brandon McMillan, the series, which will be followed immediately by Lucky Dog: Down Under, will lead a full hour of Lucky Dog programming on CBS.

Lucky Dog: Paws with Purpose follows McMillan as he pairs dogs with military veterans and families, creating matches that provide comfort, companionship and stability. Featured stories include Peaches, a mixed breed who may be the perfect match for an Air Force veteran and her son and Steve, a playful poodle being considered for a Marine Corps vet and her daughter. The series will also feature Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and Chief Pawsitivity Officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force Reservist and former military working dog handler.

"USAA has been taking care of our members every day since our founding 104 years ago, and Smoky is the embodiment of that as she is a symbol of comfort and well-being for our employees and the military community," said Chris Curtin, Chief Marketing Officer of USAA. "The stories in Lucky Dog: Paws with Purpose reflect the strength, resilience and connection that are such an important part of military life. We're proud to be part of a series that celebrates those experiences."

"The Lucky Dog franchise has always been about the transformative bond between people and animals," said Bryan Curb, president of Hearst Media Production Group. "Paws with Purpose builds on that foundation while shining a light on the unique experiences of military veterans, spouses and families. We know the show will resonate with our audiences and inspire viewers to see the comfort, connection and purpose dogs can bring to people's lives."

In the subsequent timeslot, Lucky Dog: Down Under – also hosted by Brandon McMillan and premiering its second season – takes viewers to Australia for heartwarming stories of shelter dogs as they transition from rescue and rehabilitation to cherished members of loving families.

Since its inception in 2013, the Lucky Dog franchise has helped to rescue, rehabilitate, train and re-home more than 200 dogs. The show has received three Daytime Emmy® Awards, 63 Telly Awards, seven Parents' Choice Awards and five Cynopsis Kids Imagination Awards. For his work on the series, McMillan has earned two Daytime Emmys® for Outstanding Host in a Lifestyle/Travel/Children's or Family Viewing Program.

HMPG's current program portfolio comprises more than 30 original series and hundreds of hours of content annually on leading broadcast networks and station groups and on connected TV and streaming platforms. It has a library of 85 series (6,000 episodes) and its content can be found in 100 countries.

About USAA

Founded in 1922 by 25 soldiers, USAA is among the leading providers of insurance, banking and retirement solutions and serves more than 14.5 million members of the U.S. military, veterans who have honorably served and their families. Headquartered in San Antonio, USAA has offices in seven U.S. cities and four overseas locations and employs more than 36,000 people worldwide. Each year, USAA supports national and local nonprofits serving military families and communities. With Honor Through Action, USAA advances policy, advocacy and philanthropy to support financial security, build meaningful careers and promote overall well-being across the military community. For more information about USAA, follow us on Facebook or X (@usaa), or visit usaa.com.

About Hearst Media Production Group

releases.title: Ande Raises $52M Seed and Series A to Launch The First Entertainment Operating System For Enterprises
releases.body:
Ande brings corporate entertainment into a single platform and gives venues a direct channel to enterprise bookings.

NEW YORK, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ande, the AI-native network for corporate entertainment, emerges from stealth with more than $52 million in seed and Series A funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Duration Ventures, and Sierra Ventures, with participation from Bain Capital Ventures.

Enterprises spend an estimated $325 billion a year on entertainment from client dinners and team outings to catering, sporting events, and gifting. Yet the booking and expense management behind it is fragmented across credit cards, AP systems, and consumer apps creating an extremely manual reconciliation process for finance teams.

Ande brings structure to one of the last unmanaged categories of enterprise spend by giving teams a single platform to book entertainment effortlessly, while finance and legal teams keep full visibility and control over every dollar spent.

Ande's agentic workflows surface venue availability, book experiences, route approvals, execute contracts, and reconcile expenses automatically. Executive assistants, office managers, field marketers, GTM teams, and their managers all work together in a single, multiplayer workspace in order to book team offsites and deal-closing dinners, while the agents move each request through approval, signing, and payment.

More than 60 enterprises already run their entertainment on Ande, reporting savings of 12 to 15 percent. Customers like Cloudflare, Salesforce, McGraw Hill, Netskope, Navan, Sigma Computing, Monday.com, Workato, Semgrep, Checkout, Rillet, and many more contribute to over $400 million in entertainment spend flowing through the platform annually.

"Entertainment is one of the most important things a company does. It builds culture, closes deals and deepens the relationships that matter most. Yet the infrastructure to manage it is broken on both sides of every transaction," said Lohit Sarma, CEO and co-founder of Ande.

"Ande is the first enterprise channel between corporate buyers and the world's best entertainment vendors. Part of the reason this is such a hard problem to solve is that venues and entertainment providers don't have a centralized distribution system to plug into. We had to build it. We've spent two and half years working with venues to digitize their data, and train models and agents for these workflows that are unique to enterprises," continued Sarma.

For venues on the other side of the transaction, Ande is the corporate sales and marketing channel that never existed. Venues have historically had no pipeline into the corporate market. Ande gives them a platform to market to, engage with, and transact with corporate buyers at scale. Among the current partners are 1,600 hospitality venues including some of the largest and most decorated hospitality groups like Altamarea Group, Che Fico, Gracious Hospitality, JKS, The Mina Group, MML, Nobu, Riviera Dining Group, Tao Group Hospitality, Unapologetic Foods, Bacchus Management Group, Wish You Were Here, and Wolfgang Puck. Over 93,000 entertainment venues are on Ande's network today.

"Our programs are high stakes and high visibility, with our executive leadership team and key customers at the core of each event we host," said Vicky Chung, Director of Corporate Events at Netskope. "My team and I trust Ande's platform, and especially the team behind it. I have real-time visibility into what's happening across every event, and when I need something done right, I know it will be. My team is now focused on reaching the executives that matter and scaling the program vs. worrying about the logistics."

"Entertainment is every enterprise's biggest expense line that is not yet well managed. For that reason, there are financial inefficiencies and a poor experience," notes Arif Janmohamed, Venture Partner at Lightspeed Venture Partners and Co-Founder of Duration Ventures. "Ande is the connective tissue, the perfect handshake between corporations and venues. Lohit is an exceptional founder, and the size of the market opportunity is largely unbounded."

Redpoint Ventures Managing Director Alex Bard notes, "Particularly when we invest in an early-stage company, our confidence has everything to do with the founder and their ambition. Lohit has both startup DNA and the enterprise experience to solve this problem. His vision for Ande is bold and ambitious."

About Ande

Ande is the AI-native network for corporate entertainment. Over 60 enterprises, including Cloudflare, Salesforce, and McGraw Hill already book, manage, and measure every experience through Ande, moving more than $400 million a year through a network of 93,000 entertainment providers across 90+ cities. For the vendors on the other side of the transaction, Ande is the dedicated corporate channel that's never existed. Learn more at ande.ai.

releases.body:
Endorsed by the Alliance for Pharmacy Compounding and accepted by Worldpay, ScriptSafe certifies pharmacies in 7 to 10 business days based on the licenses they already hold

WASHINGTON, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ScriptSafe launched last Tuesday, September 15, at Compounders on Capitol Hill, the Alliance for Pharmacy Compounding's annual conference. ScriptSafe certifies pharmacies for payment processing and, coming next, for online advertising.

What ScriptSafe does

ScriptSafe verifies what a pharmacy is licensed to do, against the state boards and federal databases that actually license it. The ScriptSafe system and team run a 152-point verification against all 50 state boards, the DEA, and federal databases, then issue a written decision within 7 to 10 business days. Certification covers a full year, with the pharmacy's licenses and website monitored every night.

For payment processors and online advertising platforms

ScriptSafe does not take the pharmacy's word for it, and it does not stop checking after approval. Every night, ScriptSafe checks the pharmacy's website to confirm the prescription requirement is still in place, what the pharmacy sells has not changed, and licenses and board standing are current. If a pharmacy drops its prescription gate or loses a license, the processor or platform is flagged within hours. Approval is where most certification programs stop. It is where ScriptSafe starts. Worldpay has accepted ScriptSafe certification, and ScriptSafe worked directly with Visa on the requirements for pharmacy merchants. ScriptSafe is actively pursuing recognition as a certification option for online pharmacy advertising, built on that same nightly monitoring.

For pharmacies

Pharmacies have had two certification options, both costly, often $3,000 or more, with decisions that can take six months or longer. ScriptSafe certifies pharmacies on the licenses they already hold, with no separate application fee and a written decision in 7 to 10 business days. Certification is $1,685 for a full year. APC members pay $1,348. The same documents go to the processor's underwriting team, so the pharmacy fills out one application instead of two.

"ScriptSafe's platform made it very easy to upload documents, answer questions, and finish our application. ScriptSafe is the best platform we have used for pharmacy online payment certification," said David Martinez, Senior Vice President of Specialty Veterinary Pharmacy.

"State boards of pharmacy decide whether a pharmacy can legally operate. That is how this industry is regulated," said Aaron Van Stone, founder and CEO of ScriptSafe. "ScriptSafe verifies what a pharmacy is licensed to do, against the boards and databases that actually license it. Fast, affordable, and built by people who understand pharmacy and payments."

Payment certification is live today. Online advertising certification is coming next, and pharmacies can get ahead of it by joining the waiting list at ScriptSafe.com.

ScriptSafe certifies pharmacies for payment processing and online advertising. It is accepted by Worldpay and endorsed by the Alliance for Pharmacy Compounding. Learn more at ScriptSafe.com.

releases.title: Sales Rabbit Launches Roof Rabbit to Take Roofing Contractors from First Lead to Final Payment
releases.body:
One machine runs canvassing, instant quoting, production, and payments, so the roofer who gets there first also gets paid first.

LEHI, Utah, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- In roofing, the contractor who reaches the homeowner first and quotes fastest wins the job. Sales Rabbit, the field-sales platform used by more than 225,000 sales representatives, today announced Roof Rabbit, the only connected machine that takes a roofing job from first lead to final payment. Roof Rabbit opens today in limited release, and roofing contractors can apply for early access at roofrabbit.ai.

Own the lead, own the quote, own the payment. Roof Rabbit runs the whole roofing job in one machine, one place, one login. It covers canvassing and lead generation at the door, instant roof quoting on the contractor's own website, and production, CRM, and payment. Most roofing companies run that same job across a stack of tools that don't talk to each other, and every handoff leaks revenue: the lead nobody called back, the quote that took days, the signed job re-typed into the office system, the check that shows up late. Roof Rabbit closes those leaks.

A homeowner who used to wait days for a callback can now get a full estimate from the contractor's website at any hour. A rep who used to leave the door with a maybe can now build the quote in under 30 seconds and close on the spot. Once the proposal is signed, the job goes straight to production. Nobody types it in twice. The same system handles materials, crew scheduling, and getting paid.

"In roofing, the contractor who gets to the homeowner first and closes fastest wins," said Ben Alves, CEO of Sales Rabbit. "That's the reality every operator in this business knows. The time between the knock and the collected check is where deals are made or lost, and every hour of delay is an opportunity for a competitor to get there first. We built Roof Rabbit to compress that cycle at every step."

Roof Rabbit is new. What it is built from is proven. Sales Rabbit acquired RoofLink in November 2024 for its roofing CRM and production software, and Roofle in January 2026 for its instant quoting engine, which has delivered more than 2.4 million estimates from aerial measurement data. The company took the strongest parts of all three, canvassing from Sales Rabbit, quoting from Roofle, production and payments from RoofLink, and engineered them into a single solution for the whole roofing job.

"Roofle was built to solve one specific problem: getting a real, accurate quote in front of a homeowner before anyone else could," said Travis Harvego, VP of Strategic Partnerships and Growth and Co-founder of Roofle. "More than 3,000 contractor sites are quoting online today because of it. That front-of-funnel capability is now part of a system that follows the job all the way through to payment: Roof Rabbit."

Jesse Mahan, VP, Business Owner, and a Founding Collaborator on RoofLink, points to the back-office problem in roofing companies where most margin gets lost. "After the contract is signed, you still have to manage materials, coordinate crews, track the job, and collect the money. That's where a lot of revenue disappears. RoofLink was built to make that process run without the office chasing every step, and that's what Roof Rabbit carries forward."

Roof Rabbit is live today for a limited group of roofing contractors, with access expanding in the weeks ahead. Early access includes the full product, done-for-you setup, and a direct line to the team building it. Contractors can apply at roofrabbit.ai.

About Sales Rabbit

Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Lehi, Utah, Sales Rabbit is the field-sales platform used by more than 225,000 sales representatives across roofing, solar, pest control, alarms, telecommunications, and home services. The company's software powers field teams through canvassing, lead management, and revenue operations. Roof Rabbit is Sales Rabbit's AI-native roofing machine, taking a job from first lead to final payment: canvassing, online quoting, proposals, production, and payments in one place.

releases.body:
• Minivela's Manny Ruiz will serve as creative and content strategy partner for Great American Media's new streaming destination for Latino families

     
  • Actor-producer Carlos Ponce will support creative development, talent relationships and audience engagement

NEW YORK, Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Great American Media today announced it has tapped Minivela, the Latino media entertainment and production company co-founded by media entrepreneur Manny Ruiz and actor-producer Carlos Ponce, to support the creation and production of Pure Flix Familia, Great American Media's new streaming destination created for Latino families.

Great American Media expands its Minivela partnership to help build Pure Flix Familia for Latino families.

Minivela will serve as Pure Flix Familia's programming, content and creative partner, working closely with Great American Media and Pure Flix leadership on original programming, content development, creator relationships, licensing, cultural strategy and audience engagement.

Ruiz and Ponce bring decades of experience working within the Latino community at the grassroots level, with deep track records across Hispanic media, entertainment, cultural marketing and storytelling that have connected them directly with Latino audiences, creators and communities.

"Pure Flix Familia represents an important expansion of Great American Media's mission to serve families with trusted entertainment grounded in faith and shared values," said Bill Abbott, President and CEO of Great American Media. "Manny, Carlos and the Minivela team bring a strong creative instinct and a deep understanding of Latino audiences and a commitment to faith and family entertainment. They know this community because they are part of it. Their perspective will be invaluable as we build a distinctive programming strategy and develop authentic stories that resonate across generations."

Manny Ruiz, CEO and co-founder of Minivela, will lead Minivela's work as programming, creative and content strategy partner. In this role, he will collaborate with Great American Media and Pure Flix executives to help identify original programming opportunities, cultivate relationships with Latino creators and producers, and advise on the platform's cultural and audience strategy.

"This is an opportunity to work alongside Great American Media to build a streaming destination that understands Latino families and reflects their faith, values, experiences and aspirations," Ruiz said. "Our focus will be on helping Pure Flix Familia develop authentic programming, meaningful creator relationships and a consistent content pipeline that can earn a lasting place in people's homes."

Carlos Ponce, who co-founded Minivela with Ruiz, will play a key creative and audience-facing role in the partnership. Ponce will support the development of Pure Flix Familia's creative identity, help establish relationships with actors, writers, filmmakers and other creators, and contribute to audience-engagement initiatives. He is also expected to participate as on-screen talent in future Pure Flix Familia projects.

"Authenticity begins by ensuring that the people and communities we hope to serve have a meaningful voice in the creative process," Ponce said. "We will work directly with writers, actors, filmmakers and producers who know these families because they come from these families. That is how we can help create stories audiences recognize, trust and want to share."

Minivela will help develop original movies, series and mobile-first microdramas; identify potential content and acquisition opportunities; cultivate emerging and established Latino talent; and advise on programming, social media, community partnerships and audience-growth initiatives. The expanded relationship gives Minivela a broader leadership role in the development and operation of Pure Flix Familia.

Great American Media will retain responsibility for Pure Flix Familia's business operations and final approval over its brand, budget, programming, acquisitions and distribution.

The expanded partnership builds upon Great American Media and Minivela's previously announced development, distribution and marketing relationship that was initially only focused on producing mobile-first microdramas for U.S. Hispanic and Latin American audiences.

Pure Flix Familia is scheduled to launch in early October with Spanish-language entertainment and will expand over time to include bilingual and English-language programming created and curated for Latino audiences. The service is part of Great American Media's broader strategy to grow its faith-and-family entertainment ecosystem and reach new audiences with programming families can confidently enjoy together.

Additional details about Pure Flix Familia's launch programming, subscription options, supported devices and availability will be announced separately.

ABOUT GREAT AMERICAN MEDIA

Great American Media is a leader in faith-and-family entertainment and one of the fastest-growing entertainment networks on television. Great American Media is home to a portfolio of brands that celebrate faith, family and country, including Great American Family, the flagship linear network featuring original Christmas movies, romantic comedies and beloved series; Great American Pure Flix, a leading faith-and-family streaming service; Great American Faith & Living, the company's unscripted companion network; and GFam+, an app that allows viewers to watch Great American Media programming anytime and anywhere.

Established in June 2021 by Bill Abbott and a group of U.S.-based family offices, Great American Media programming is available through cable and satellite providers, Great American Pure Flix, YouTube TV and the GFam+ app.

ABOUT PURE FLIX FAMILIA

Pure Flix Familia is an operating entity within Great American Pure Flix and Great American Media dedicated to culturally relevant entertainment centered on faith and family. The streaming destination is being developed to serve Spanish-dominant, bilingual and English-dominant Latino audiences through original movies, series, mobile-first microdramas and thoughtfully curated programming that families can confidently enjoy together.

ABOUT MINIVELA

Minivela is a Latino-focused entertainment and production company co-founded by media entrepreneur Manny Ruiz and actor-producer Carlos Ponce. The company develops culturally relevant programming for U.S. Hispanic and Latin American audiences, with an emphasis on mobile-first storytelling, emerging creative formats and authentic relationships with Latino creators and communities.

releases.title: Media One Acquires Premex Solutions, Expanding Its Digital Textile Portfolio into Home Décor and Apparel
releases.body:
Acquisition strengthens Media One's home décor and apparel offering with expanded fabrics, pigment printing technology and technical expertise

GARDEN GROVE, Calif., Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Media One ("M1"), a leading full-service integrator and value-added distributor of wide-format printing solutions, announced today that it has acquired the U.S. business and assets of Premex Solutions, a leading supplier of high-quality, print-ready fabrics for the digital textile printing industry. Premex Solutions builds on the more than 40-year textile heritage of its parent company, Premier Textiles UK, an independent family-run business founded in 1981, with a modern focus on digitally printable fabrics for the U.S. market.

The acquisition builds on Media One's growing portfolio, alongside Fisher Textiles and Hyperflex Vinyls, and expands the range of applications and solutions Media One and Fisher Textiles can bring to its customers in the home décor, interior décor and fashion markets. Premex Solutions brings an extensive range of high-quality, print-ready fabrics, deep textile knowledge and technical expertise, and established customer relationships that round out Media One and Fisher Textiles' existing product and service offerings.

"We're excited to welcome Premex Solutions to the Media One family," said Jake Feldman, Chief Executive Officer of Media One. "Premex has developed best-in-class print-ready and pre-treated fabrics, along with real technical depth in natural and specialty textiles that complements our own printing technology and service expertise. Paired with our differentiated printing solutions, distribution scale and nationwide technical support, we can now bring an end-to-end, industry-leading solution to the home décor and apparel markets."

Premex Solutions will join Media One's growing portfolio alongside Fisher Textiles and Hyperflex Vinyls. The combination extends Media One's integrated model into home décor and apparel, bringing together print-ready fabrics, printing equipment, inks, finishing solutions and nationwide technical service under one organization. Premex Solutions customers will continue to work with the people and products they know today while gaining access to Media One's broader capabilities and support.

"Premier Textiles has been my family's business for more than four decades, and we are extremely proud of the reputation, relationships and textile expertise we have built over that time," said Ashok Kallumpram, Managing Director of Premier Textiles. "Premex Solutions represents an important extension of that legacy into the U.S. digital printing market, so finding the right long-term home for the business was very important to us. We believe Media One shares our commitment to customers, people and the textile industry and has the capabilities and vision to build on that legacy for many years to come."

"This is an exciting next chapter for Premex Solutions," said Nick Smith, Managing Director of Premier Digital Textiles. "Combining our textile expertise and product portfolio with Media One's broader digital print capabilities creates meaningful opportunities for our customers and our team. We look forward to supporting a smooth transition and helping build on the momentum Premex Solutions has created in the U.S. market."

Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

About Media One

Media One Digital Imaging, LLC is the only full-service integrator and value-added distributor of large format printing solutions in the United States. The company provides best-in-class printers, inks, fabrics, paper, vinyl, laminates, equipment, finishing solutions, color management, software, and training and maintenance services to print providers nationwide. Through its portfolio, including Fisher Textiles and Hyperflex Vinyls, Media One is a true one-stop solution for the large-format and textile printing industry.

About Premex Solutions

Premex Solutions is a leader in high-quality, print-ready fabrics for the digital textile market, serving customers across home furnishings, interior décor, fashion and related applications. Based in Marietta, Georgia, Premex Solutions combines deep textile knowledge, technical expertise and innovation to deliver a broad range of fabrics designed for digital printing. Premex Solutions is currently a subsidiary of Premier Textiles, an independent, family-run textile business founded in 1981 with more than 40 years of textile industry experience.

releases.title: Arc XP Launches Compass: A Home Page That Knows Who's Reading It, and a Newsroom That Still Decides What Leads
releases.body:
Arc XP Compass recognizes a returning reader, remembers what they read last, and shows them what they missed. Editors still decide what leads.

WASHINGTON, Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Arc XP, the media technology platform built inside The Washington Post, launched Arc XP Compass, a personalization engine for news home pages and section fronts. Arc XP Compass tells a returning reader from a first-time one, remembers what each read last, and rebuilds the page around it. It is the experience Instagram and TikTok trained a generation to expect, applied to news. The difference is who sets the priorities: editors still decide what leads.

Publishers just crossed a threshold. Social media and video networks have, for the first time, overtaken publishers' own websites and apps as the most common way people get news, used by 54% of respondents across 48 markets against 51% for news organizations' own sites and apps, according to the Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism's Digital News Report 2026.

Catch Me Up is the clearest example. A wildfire breaks out Monday, and a reader follows the first evacuation orders that night. She is off the news for three days. By Thursday, the story has moved four times: containment lines held, two neighborhoods cleared to return, the county opened an investigation into the local utility, the casualty count revised. Arc XP Compass knows she was here and where she stopped, and opens with a recap of what changed while she was gone, in order, built from the newsroom's own reporting rather than a generated summary. A first-time visitor sees none of it.

Behind that summary, every update on the fire sits in a single storyline called Dynamic Timelines, instead of scattering across a dozen separate links. Editors keep their hands on the wheel: Editorial Priority Controls lets them pin, boost, or bury any story directly, so the personalization never drifts from the newsroom's own judgment.

The pressure is concentrated among younger readers. Among 18-to-24-year-olds, 52% now name social media, video networks or AI chatbots as their main way of getting news, 32 points ahead of the next source. Publishers' own sites and apps are no longer the main source of news for any age group globally. Ten percent worldwide used a standalone AI chatbot for news last week, up from 7% a year earlier, and 16% among under-35s. Referral traffic is fragile too: Google Discover traffic to Reach, the UK's largest commercial news publisher, fell 46% in the second half of 2025, per the company's investor disclosure.

A general-purpose chatbot cannot replicate what a newsroom builds over years: an editorial voice, a reader's trust, and an archive of its own reporting. Global trust in answers from AI chatbots sits at 20%, against 37% for news overall. Arc XP calls the approach adaptive discovery.

Arc XP Compass is platform-agnostic. It works with any content management system or delivery stack, whether or not a newsroom runs the rest of its site on the Arc XP hybrid CMS platform.

"Publishers don't want to hand their relationship with readers over to somebody else's algorithm. They want a better version of their own front page," said Ryan Gladstone, Director of Product Engineering, Arc XP. "Arc XP Compass lets a newsroom's priorities guide the experience while still meeting each reader where they left off. A chatbot can't do that, and a generic recommendation engine won't respect the newsroom."

Availability

Arc XP Compass is generally available beginning September 2026. To view a short video of Arc XP Compass, please visit: https://hubs.la/Q04xNZX50   

About Arc XP

Arc XP is the platform for modern media, built inside The Washington Post, which still runs on it today. Newsrooms, digital publishers, and broadcasters use Arc XP to publish faster, own their audience relationships, and diversify revenue, including The Irish Times, Libération, L'Express, Madsack, Graham Media Group, and Sky News. Arc Intelligence grounds AI in each organization's own content and governance rules, so editors stay in control of what is published. Arc XP supports more than 3,000 sites worldwide, with a migration path proven by publishers who've already made the move. Learn more at www.arcxp.com.

Sources for cited statistics: Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, Digital News Report 2026 (reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2026). Reach figure as reported by Press Gazette, 3 March 2026, and cited in the same report.

LONDON and NEW YORK, Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- International award-winning luxury marketing agency, Issa PR, announces the upcoming release of a new academic book - The Future of Luxury: An Evolution of Culture, Capital & Consciousness. Published by leading academic publisher, Cambridge Scholars Publishing, the book will launch this autumn 2026. The book is edited by Issa PR founder and CEO, Viet N'Guyen, who also wrote the preface. Alongside a cadre of leading industry contributors, the new academic text provides a comprehensive examination of how global luxury is being reshaped by generational shifts, digital transformation, the importance of sustainability, and ethical expectations.

The luxury industry has undergone rapid and radical changes over the last few decades. This interdisciplinary collection of essays explores the evolving landscape of the luxury industry through the lens of cultural relevance, immersive technology, social responsibility and decentralisation of brand authority. Drawing on insights from eight global thought leaders across London and New York, the collection examines how authenticity and community co-creation are replacing exclusivity as the new markers of prestige, and how luxury's future is being defined not only by craftsmanship but by meaning, identity, and innovation. Cultural capital is now integral to driving value while propelling loyalty while understanding consumer consciousness is now critical to the success of a brand.

Key themes explored in the book include: the digital revolution in art, the rise of phygital experiences, the integration of AI in storytelling, photography and filmmaking, the role of art, fashion and entertainment in shaping cultural capital, and new paradigms for the industry. It will also include an analysis of the changing face of luxury consumers around the world and core tenets for success. The book brings together perspectives from leading figures across fashion, film, art, automotives, media, cinematography, photography and cultural strategy, including key contributors who will discuss the future of their industry:

– Bianca Saunders: Award-winning British menswear designer explores the future of fashion

– Bruno Centofanti: Film director, writer and producer posits the future of luxury storytelling and cinematography

– Felipe Franco: Luxury automotive filmmaker, creative leader and entrepreneur analyses the future of the automotive industry

– Jonathan Saw: D&I expert and leader assesses today ' s luxury consumer, and socioeconomic changes around the globe today

– Mark Dale: Founder of pioneering digital art gallery, W1 Curates, explores the future of art

– Nicole Ingra: Strategist and founder of Ingra Labs creates a codex framework for cultural success and discusses the future of culture

– Soo Kim: Newsweek's Life & Trends reporter analyses the future of design, travel and the workplace

– Stefan Jakubowski: Fashion photographer retrospectively reviews, then assesses the future of photography

Cambridge Scholars Publishing is a major academic publishing house, who produce books for universities, libraries, entrepreneurs, and business leaders worldwide.

AI & Phygital Experiences: Integrating AI into storytelling and photography, alongside technology's impact on high-end retail.

Sustainability, CSR & Social Impact: Redefining modern luxury for next-generation consumers and the need to integrate social responsibility into business.

Cultural Capital & Cultural Relevance: What cultural capital means and encompasses today and the intersections of art, fashion, and entertainment. The ongoing digital revolution in art.

The New Luxury Consumer: Shifting demographics, emerging nations as new luxury power players, and changing consumer behaviors.

New Business Frameworks: Essential non-negotiables in luxury marketing, and paradigms for business innovation and success.

Written for industry professionals, academics, students, and business innovators, the publication outlines necessary frameworks for luxury marketing and critical strategies in an era defined by meaning and technological advancements. The book will explore some of the most important themes of today and will feature esteemed leaders, and visionaries across multiple industries. As well as providing a future-forward perspective on luxury, the book will also provide actionable insights for each sector."

releases.title: A New Episode of Advancements to Broadcast on Saturday, September 26 at 8:00 p.m. ET
releases.body:
Discover how new technologies, tools, and approaches are addressing some of the greatest challenges facing society today.

JUPITER, Fla., Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- An upcoming episode of Advancements with Ted Danson is scheduled to broadcast on Saturday, September 26, 2026, at 8:00 pm ET. Tune in to Bloomberg Television to watch.

Across four featured segments, the program examines how organizations are responding to growing demands for infrastructure, sustainability, continuous healthcare, and more adaptable industrial systems. The episode opens with a look at the evolution of construction and megaproject delivery. As demand grows for semiconductor fabrication facilities, clean energy projects, advanced manufacturing, transportation, and other infrastructure, the construction industry faces pressure to deliver projects faster and at greater scale. Watch to discover how artificial intelligence, automation, project data, and other technologies are being applied to the construction industry and are empowering a new generation of skilled craft professionals, engineers, and project managers.

The program then turns to the challenge of making food packaging more recyclable. Packaging represents roughly one-third of municipal solid waste in the United States, while food packaging presents its own challenges, because of contamination, complex materials, and recycling systems that are not always equipped to process them. The segment examines how packaging design can influence recyclability. Industry experts explore approaches involving recyclable P.E.T. packaging, pad-less tray designs, and clearer consumer disposal information designed to support better recycling outcomes and a more circular materials economy.

Healthcare is the focus of the third segment, which examines the movement from episodic care toward more continuous care. While American healthcare provides highly advanced acute and specialty services, care is frequently organized around individual encounters, such as hospitalizations, physician visits, tests, and follow-ups. Learn about the clinical "white space" between those encounters and how remote monitoring, clinical intelligence, communication, and human decision-making can work together to provide greater visibility into a patient's health journey. The segment will share how continuous specialty care can extend beyond traditional healthcare settings and into the home and will include patient stories illustrating the potential impact of earlier intervention and ongoing support.

The episode concludes with an examination of modernizing industrial control systems. Learn why the demands of AI, advanced analytics, and cybersecurity are changing what manufacturers need from their automation systems. The show will educate about the limitations of traditional closed control architectures, including vendor lock-in and interoperability challenges, as it introduces Open Process Automation (OPA) as an approach based upon open, standards-based architectures. Viewers will see how the technology can allow hardware and software from different suppliers to work together, giving manufacturers greater flexibility to upgrade and adapt their systems over time.

This episode examines how industries are adapting established systems to meet rapidly changing demands. From construction sites and food packaging facilities to patients' homes and industrial plants, emerging technologies are being used alongside new operating models and human expertise to improve how complex systems function," said Dustin Schwarz, programming director for the Advancements series.

Featured segments in this episode include Bechtel, Lucid Corp, Streamcare Group, and Collaborative Systems Integration (CSI).

Advancements is an information-based educational television series that explores recent developments taking place across several industries and economies. With a focus on some of the major innovations responsible for global progress today, the award-winning series goes behind-the-scenes to discover and share how technology and innovation continue to drive the world forward.

releases.title: Velocys expands Fischer-Tropsch reactor roadmap with AlphaCore 800 for larger-scale SAF and e-fuels projects
releases.body:
Larger-capacity microchannel reactor is designed to reduce reactor count, simplify FT configuration and lower FT unit cost

HOUSTON and OXFORD, England, Sept. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Velocys, a Fischer-Tropsch technology licensor for sustainable fuels, today announced the release of the new AlphaCore™ 800 reactor, its highest-capacity microchannel Fischer-Tropsch (FT) reactor to date. It is designed to produce up to 800 barrels per day, or 30,000 tonnes per year (30 kt/a) of FT fluids from a single reactor.

AlphaCore 800 doubles the capacity of AlphaCore 400 and extends Velocys' throughput-based AlphaCore reactor family from approximately 50 to 800 barrels per day per reactor (from 2 to 30 kt/a per reactor). AlphaCore 800 is designed particularly for larger sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and e-fuels projects, including SAF plants targeting approximately 100,000 tonnes per year and above.

Benefits from expanding reactor size while preserving the underlying chemistry and design are clear: more FT capacity per reactor, enabling fewer reactors as project scale increases without sacrificing performance or reliability. Reducing reactor count can simplify the FT island, reduce associated equipment requirements and lower FT unit cost.

For example, an FT plant requiring approximately 1,600 barrels per day (60 kt/a) of FT liquids could be configured with two AlphaCore 800 reactors. This reduces total reactor count by 75% compared to an FT unit utilizing eight AlphaCore 200 reactors while maintaining the same FT liquids capacity.

"Customers are asking us to bring our microchannel FT technology into larger projects with simpler configurations," said Matthew Viergutz, CEO of Velocys. "AlphaCore 800 is a direct response. As SAF projects move toward 100,000 tonnes per year and beyond, we are increasing capacity per reactor so developers can configure larger FT plants with fewer units while building on the technology platform and operating experience of Velocys."

AlphaCore 800 joins AlphaCore 50, 200 and 400 in the Velocys reactor portfolio, giving project developers a throughput-based product range built with the same core technology that can be applied across multiple project scales and syngas pathways.

The Velocys roadmap reflects growing market demand for scalable SAF and e-fuels production, where developers look to reduce plant complexity, improve repeatability and strengthen the commercial case for larger FT-based projects.

About Velocys

Velocys is a Fischer-Tropsch technology licensor for sustainable fuels. Its microFTL™ platform combines AlphaCore™ microchannel reactors, SQRCAT™ catalyst and process know-how to convert synthesis gas into liquid hydrocarbons for SAF, renewable diesel and other synthetic fuels.

Learn more at Velocys.com.

releases.title: PBS Western Reserve & Ideastream Public Media Announce Merger to Strengthen the Future of Public Media Across Northeast Ohio and Western Pennsylvania
releases.body:
Long-time partners join forces, retaining staff and sustaining programming across the region

KENT, Ohio and CLEVELAND, Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- PBS Western Reserve and Ideastream Public Media today announced that their boards have approved an agreement to merge, creating a combined public media organization serving more than 4 million people across Northeast Ohio and Western Pennsylvania.

"At a time of growing pressures for public media organizations nationwide, this is about taking action now to protect something that matters deeply to the communities we serve," said Kevin Martin, President & CEO, Ideastream Public Media. "Despite losing a combined $4 million in annual federal funds, both PBS Western Reserve and Ideastream Public Media are strong today. We believe we can be even stronger together in the future."

This agreement follows a comprehensive due diligence process, undertaken by both organizations in the wake of the July 2025 federal elimination of Corporation for Public Broadcasting (CPB) funding, reductions in state-level public media funding, rising operating costs, and broader uncertainty around future public funding priorities. That process led to today's determination that coming together now is the best way to ensure long-term effectiveness of public media across every part of the region.

Continuity Across the Combined Organization

PBS Western Reserve and Ideastream Public Media bring a long history of collaboration to the merger, sharing a commitment to local and national news, educational programming, and cultural content.

"For years, our organizations have worked alongside one another with a common belief in the value of public media and the responsibility to serve the people and places that count on us," said Natalie Pillsbury, President & CEO, PBS Western Reserve. "This merger builds on that history and gives us an opportunity to bring our people, experience, and resources together to make our work even stronger."

That commitment to strength and stability extends across the organization. No layoffs are planned as a result of the merger, and the organizations intend to retain all existing staff. The two existing boards will join, ensuring consistent representation from across the region.

Moving forward, Pillsbury will become Chief Content Officer at Ideastream Public Media, succeeding the organization's retiring Chief Content Officer. The role's responsibilities will expand under the combined organization to include strategic oversight of programming and content. Pillsbury brings more than a decade of experience in public media to the position, including prior roles at Ideastream Public Media and WKSU. Martin will remain President & CEO of Ideastream Public Media, a role he has held since 2017.

On the programming side, local and cultural programming, local news coverage, and educational services will continue without interruption across the organizations' NPR and PBS affiliations, including three television stations, WVIZ, WNEO, and WEAO, along with NPR programming on WKSU and classical and jazz music on WCLV and JazzNEO.

A Stronger Future for Public Media

The merger creates a public media footprint spanning Cleveland, Akron, Canton, Youngstown, and Western Pennsylvania, from the region's largest urban population centers to its small, rural communities. Over time, the combined organization's greater capacity could create opportunities to expand educational offerings and locally relevant storytelling, invest in new technologies, and find new ways to connect with audiences throughout the region.

Both organizations are working collaboratively to finalize the transaction, starting with filing for the license transfer with the FCC and completing a merger filing with the State of Ohio. Existing licenses, branding, call letters, and locations will remain in place throughout the closing period. Once the transaction is complete, it is anticipated that the combined organization will operate under the Ideastream Public Media name.

Additional information about the merger, including FAQs, can be found on the websites for www.ideastream.org/merger and www.pbswesternreserve.org/merger.

About PBS Western Reserve

PBS Western Reserve is a community organization that empowers Northeast Ohio and Western Pennsylvania through the impact of accessible public media and educational services to foster connection and lifelong learning. PBS Western Reserve presents cultural, scientific and artistic programming for awareness and enjoyment; local storytelling and access to trusted regional, state and national public affairs; experiential opportunities and community outreach for people of all ages; and educational initiatives that support the healthy development of youth. 

PBS Western Reserve is made up of two separately licensed public television stations (WNEO and WEAO) and an Educational Services division operating under one 501(c)(3) nonprofit corporation, Northeastern Educational Television of Ohio Inc. (NETO). WNEO was established in 1971, is licensed to the city of Alliance and serves the Youngstown designated television market. WEAO went on the air in 1975, is licensed to the city of Akron and serves the Cleveland-Akron-Canton designated television market. All programming is simulcast on both stations.

About Ideastream Public Media

Ideastream Public Media serves as Ohio's largest independent, publicly supported media organization. Ideastream is the home of Northeast Ohio's PBS, NPR, and classical and jazz music public broadcasting stations: WVIZ, WKSU, WCLV and JazzNEO. Free programs and services are made available to 3.6 million people in 22 counties across radio, TV, and digital platforms, meeting the communities we serve where and when they need us.
