releases.title: 2factor launches high performance competitor to leveraged ETFs, for Coinbase's Tokenized Stocks on Base
releases.body:
Leveraged ETFs are notoriously inefficient and cannot be held for long. Banks that supply leverage are constrained by hedging costs, and these charges are passed on to holders — compounding against performance year after year. Which is why leverage has been limited to short-term use. 2factor structurally eliminates this cost onchain, making leverage viable for the dominant capital base in finance: the $112 trillion population of buy-and-hold investors.

SAN FRANCISCO, Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- 2factor.finance announced today its launch on Base for Coinbase's tokenized stocks, giving long-term investors moderate leverage they can hold indefinitely, at a fraction of what a leveraged ETF costs to carry. It is a rare case of an onchain product beating its traditional counterpart on performance rather than on access.

Tokenized equities may turn out to be an even larger development than people think. When Coinbase listed real equities onchain, the assets were the smaller half of the announcement. The larger half was opening them: any developer can now compose a listed stock with any other asset or protocol built onchain. What that unlocks is still mostly unknown. 2factor is an early answer, and not one anybody was forecasting. If structured products can be built better onchain than off, the question is how much else can be.

LEVERAGED ETFS CANNOT BE HELD, LIMITING THEM TO SHORT-TERM USE

Beta slippage, or beta decay, is the gap between the multiple on the label and what a holder actually earns. Hold a 3x fund for a year and you do not get 3x. Hold it for several and you often do worse than the stock itself.

This decay decomposes into two costs that compound against holders. Volatility drag is mathematical — the gap between arithmetic and compound returns — and cannot be engineered away. Financing drag is a charge: leveraged ETFs buy their exposure from banks that must hedge it, and the price of that hedging is passed through to the holder. Across the roughly $250 billion held in leveraged ETFs, investors pay an estimated $10 billion annually in financing above the risk-free rate.

Only about a third of single-stock leveraged ETFs have beaten simply holding the stock. No crypto leveraged ETF has ever beaten spot over its own lifetime.

2FACTOR CUTS THE COST OF LEVERAGE BY 75 PERCENT

The obstacle has always been structural. Leverage has to come from somewhere. Traditionally it comes from an intermediary who takes the other side and hedges it, and whose price reflects what short exposure costs to carry. Shorts are expensive. So the cost of being long has always been set by the cost of being short.

How expensive depends on how deep the hedging market is, not on how risky the asset is. In the big equity indices, where dealers hedge cheaply, leverage runs 4 to 5 percent a year. On a single stock it runs 8 to 86 percent. Competition does not compress it, because the price is set by the dealer's hedging cost rather than the issuer's margin.

2factor breaks that link. It sources leverage from investors seeking stable yield rather than from investors willing to be short. Stable yield is far cheaper than short exposure, and the savings are passed to holders — roughly a 75 percent reduction in the all-in cost of holding a leveraged single-stock position.

AND GROWS ITS ADDRESSABLE MARKET BY 750 PERCENT

A 3x position destroys capital over long horizons regardless of what it costs, because volatility drag scales with the square of leverage. So 2factor sets leverage targets that compound in favor of long-term holders — Kelly-optimal multiples that account for drag, roughly 1.33x for cbBTC, rather than the 2x and 3x the industry applies to every asset alike.

The difference shows up on the hardest asset there is. Over the past decade, one dollar in 3x Bitcoin went to zero. One dollar at 1.33x grew to approximately $506, against $281 for spot. Equities are far less volatile, which makes the range where leverage helps wider for a listed stock, not narrower.

The idea is not new. More than half a century of portfolio theory holds that moderate leverage maximizes growth for long-duration capital — at current equity volatilities, somewhere between 1.5x and 2x. Traditional finance has never disagreed. It has never been able to build the instrument.

Cheap financing and correct sizing together produce leverage that can be held like a spot position. Approximately 88 percent of investable capital — roughly $112 trillion — buys and holds; only about $15 trillion trades on shorter horizons. Leverage priced and sized for traders serves the smaller number. Leverage built to be held serves both — a 750 percent increase in the capital that can use it.

"I want to own moderately leveraged Google for exactly the same reason I want to own moderately leveraged Bitcoin. I don't know what path it will take, but I think the position will simply be worth more in five years," said Evan Kuo, co-founder of 2factor. "That is not an exotic wish. It is the most ordinary thing an investor can want, and until now there was no way to act on it that survived a bad quarter."

ON-CHAIN SOLUTIONS NOW OUTPERFORM THEIR TRADITIONAL ALTERNATIVES

This is not a workaround for investors who cannot reach traditional markets. Onchain products have generally won where access was the binding constraint; this one does not need that. It is a better instrument than the traditional alternative, for an investor with full access to both — and against a single-stock leveraged ETF held for years, the margin is not close.

Every structure traditional finance cannot assemble — programmable collateral, counterparties who never meet, terms that adjust without an administrator — is now buildable on a listed stock. And now there is proof they can be built better.

"Listing the assets was the first step, but opening them was the more important one," said Brian Armstrong, co-founder and CEO of Coinbase. "Putting a stock onchain is only interesting if it lets people do something they could not do before — otherwise we have rebuilt the same brokerage with extra steps. 2factor clears that bar, and it is exactly the kind of thing we opened these assets up for."

releases.body:
United flyers won't miss a play this football season, with live broadcasts from ABC, CBS, NBC, FOX, FS1, ESPN, ESPN2, NFL Network and TNF on Prime Video on Starlink-enabled seatback screens starting this week through the big game in February

Starlink is the fastest, most reliable WiFi in the sky and live TV streaming on seatback screens is now on board more than 220 mainline aircraft for customers in every class of service – up to 700 flights per day – with plans to reach 700 mainline planes early next year

United sponsors nine NFL teams and expects to operate 200+ team charter flights this season for 11 teams.

CHICAGO, Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- United Airlines customers won't miss a play this football season, thanks to a new agreement between the airline and DISH. Starting this week, travelers can catch live professional and college football games right on their Starlink-enabled seatback screen.

Starlink is the fastest, most reliable Wi-Fi in the sky and United is installing Starlink at a rapid rate - and, fans can now watch live broadcasts from ABC, CBS, NBC, FOX, FS1, ESPN, ESPN2, NFL Network and TNF on Prime Video on more than 200 Starlink-equipped airplanes – about 700 of flights per day. The service will be available on domestic flights through the big game in February, and United expects to have Starlink on nearly 700 airplanes by then.

Starlink is free for MileagePlus members in every class of service, and the airline expects to complete installations before the end of 2027.

This new entertainment offering builds on the airline's long history of supporting professional football, sponsoring nine professional football teams in New York, Chicago, San Francisco, Houston, Washington D.C., Denver, Kansas City, Cleveland and Nashville and operating more than 200 team charter flights for 11 teams this season.

"Starlink opens a whole new world of features and benefits for our customers, regardless of where they sit on the plane – now football fans don't have to schedule their flights around game day," said Andrew Nocella, United's Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer. "Instead, they can watch their favorite team on seatback and also make changes to their fantasy roster, text or live chat with friends, or even stream different games on their phone, laptop or tablet, just like they would do at home."

United's new agreement represents a collaborative effort with DISH, utilizing its OnStream platform, to deliver content to next-generation aviation environments.

"With United, we are helping to rewrite the inflight playbook," said Amir Ahmed, Executive Vice President, Video Services, DISH. "Whether you're sitting on your couch or cruising at 35,000 feet, you should be able to watch your favorite teams play. By pairing DISH's OnStream platform with United's Starlink connectivity, we're keeping fans connected to the moments that matter most."

Starlink Sets a New Standard for Live Entertainment in Flight

This new service is just the latest example of how United is using Starlink to redefine the inflight entertainment experience. Last month, United partnered with ESPN to host a first-of-its kind live Fantasy Football Draft from 30,000 feet where ESPN analyst Tyler Fulghum made his picks live from the sky during the two-hour broadcast. And earlier this summer, United customers could stream the biggest soccer tournament in the world onboard Starlink-powered domestic flights.

Starlink is now active on more than 560 United mainline and United Express® aircraft and the airline has already flown more than 31 million passengers on Starlink-powered aircraft across more than 464,000 flights, powering 14.2 million devices.

Starlink is just one way United is investing nose to tail in its customer experience. The airline continues to install seatback screens across its fleet – up to 1,000 aircraft before the end of 2027 – and is rolling out new airplanes with 27-inch, 4K OLED seatback screens, the largest among U.S. carriers. Passengers can now access more than 2,500 hours of premium entertainment content including Apple TV, HBO Max, A24 and Spotify.

Football Flies United

Separately, for the second year in a row, United is celebrating the intersection of football, fashion and travel for its Football Flies United advertising campaign. Featuring New York Giants head coach John Harbaugh, Giants players Abdul Carter and Arvell Reese, and Chicago Bears players Rome Odunze, Luther Burden III and Colston Loveland, the campaign is built around a simple idea: how you arrive matters. Whether stepping off a plane for game day or arriving for an important business meeting, traveling well can help people feel refreshed, confident and ready to work – no matter what comes next.

"When our players step off the plane, we want them to feel rested, confident and ready to compete. Football Flies United celebrates the idea that when you travel well and feel your best, you're going to perform at your best," said Coach Harbaugh. "And for football fans traveling this season, they can bring that same game-day energy with them knowing they won't have to miss a play – they can watch their favorite teams live on United flights all season long."

The campaign is featured across prominent out-of-home locations in Chicago and New York, including Wrigleyville and Penn Station, with additional content rolling out across social media throughout the NFL season. The teams and locations were chosen to highlight United's roots as Chicago's hometown airline, and its global reach with Newark as a gateway to more than 90 international destinations.

The airline will also charter flights for the Washington Commanders, New Orleans Saints and San Francisco 49ers for their international games in London, Paris and Mexico City.

About United

At United, Good Leads The Way. With U.S. hubs in Chicago, Denver, Houston, Los Angeles, New York/Newark, San Francisco and Washington, D.C., United operates the most comprehensive global route network among North American carriers and is now the largest airline in the world as measured by available seat miles. For more about how to join the United team, please visit www.united.com/careers and more information about the company is at www.united.com. United Airlines Holdings, Inc., the parent company of United Airlines, Inc., is traded on the Nasdaq under the symbol "UAL".

releases.title: Notes.fm Raises $5 Million to Unify Royalties, Publishing, and Distribution for Independent Artists
releases.body:
New funding from leading artists and music industry executives—including Zach Bryan, Benny Blanco, Tainy, Ari Emanuel, Julie Greenwald, Sam Hendel, and others—supports the next phase of growth as Notes.fm builds a new financial layer for the music economy

Download Image Assets Here

NEW YORK, Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Notes.fm, the music royalty collection platform helping musicians and music companies identify and collect 100% of their royalties, announces it has raised $5 million from leading artists, managers, executives and strategic partners across the music industry. Notes is the latest venture from Stem co-founder Tim Luckow, on a mission to support independent artists with the best-in-class technology for distribution and publishing under one roof so they can have full control over their earnings and stop missing out on money that is rightfully theirs.

The round includes participation from a range of influential artists and music industry leaders from Benny Blanco, Zach Bryan and his managers Stefan Max and Danny Kang, Tainy, Blake Slatkin, and Mt. Joy frontman Matt Quinn, WME Group Executive Chairman Ari Emanuel, Chord Music founder Sam Hendel, longtime Atlantic Records chief and 26.2 founder Julie Greenwald, as well as many of the industry's leading companies including Foundations, Mick Management, Twenty Ten Management, Triple 8, KMGMT, Good Boy, Mexican Summer, and Breakaway. The funding will support continued platform development and scaled marketing efforts as Notes expands its offering to artists globally.

Notes recently debuted a new feature "Releases" and unveiled its new partnership with Stripe, to streamline distribution, publishing admin and money management into one simplified release flow for musicians. This allows artists to use Notes.fm as the home for both distribution and royalty collection, making it easy for artists and their teams to take simultaneous ownership of their creative output and the income it generates. Notes is founded on the principle that every artist should receive all of their royalties. That's why they take 0% participation in distribution and publishing royalties, charging a flat monthly subscription fee instead. It's the same ethos behind their catalog royalty review technology, which helps rights owners identify missing royalties across their catalog and fix the issues so they can claim all of the royalties they've earned while they can.

This isn't new for Notes. Since launch, they've rolled out capabilities that allow artists and rights holders to more seamlessly manage their earnings, including integrated financial accounts designed to give users more flexibility in how they collect, store, and transfer, and earn on income. These updates are part of a broader effort to build a more complete financial layer for the modern music ecosystem.

Prior to Releases, Notes also announced  Credits.fm, a free and open music credits database indexing more than 150 million song codes and credits to help the music industry organize, verify, and connect the data powering royalties and artist compensation in the age of AI.

"Music is evolving quickly, and the finance systems around it need to evolve at a faster rate," said Tim Luckow, CEO and co-founder of Notes.fm. "Between all of the actions required to properly release, credit and collect on music, there are a lot of places where money falls through the cracks. We built Notes to bring all of that into one platform — so artists can release music and collect every royalty from day one, and recover what's historically been missed."

"Having spent our careers working with artists at every level, we've seen firsthand how much value gets lost to fragmented, unnecessarily complex systems," adds co-founder Derek Davies. "The response to Notes from the music community has been incredibly meaningful, and we're proud to announce a raise funded almost exclusively by artists, managers and music industry strategics who have a native understanding of these issues firsthand. This raise gives us the resources to keep building the infrastructure and applications that we believe the next generation of artists deserves."

Notes has created an artist-friendly, automated process to simplify a notoriously complex and outdated system that has historically led to hundreds of millions of dollars in royalties going unclaimed by artists every year. Notes brings clarity to the complexity, requiring only a musician name and list of songs to start reviewing streaming services, collection societies, and registries like the MLC and SoundExchange. The platform not only identifies missing royalties, but it also helps an artist fix issues and directly claim the royalties that result from those corrections while ensuring future income flows correctly.

Following its public launch last year, Notes has already demonstrated strong early traction, identifying more than $10 million in previously unclaimed royalties across a broad range of artists and catalogs including James Blake, Zach Bryan, Mt. Joy, Girl In Red and more. The platform continues to grow across both emerging and established artists, reflecting a shared demand for greater clarity and access in how music earnings are tracked and distributed.

By bringing together royalty discovery, payments infrastructure, and music-centric financial management into a single experience, Notes.fm is helping to create a new system that better supports artists as their careers and audiences grow.

About Notes.fm

Notes.fm is a music royalty collection platform built to help independent musicians, artists and music companies collect all of their royalties in one easy-to-use place. Founded by Stem co-founder Tim Luckow, Notes brings distribution, publishing, and financial tools under one roof, giving musicians and companies the technology to release music, verify song credits, manage their catalogs, and collect every royalty they're owed. Music Royalties, Simplified.

Learn more at www.notes.fm.

The Untold: Chelsey Northern (cn@wearetheuntold.com), Chloé Snyder (cs@wearetheuntold.com), Cory Councill (cc@wearetheuntold.com)

releases.title: Kapwork Launches Free $42.45 Billion BEAD Tracker and Invoice Certification for Contractors
releases.body:
Free data from 80 plus federal agencies shows where the work is; free invoice certification helps the businesses doing it get funded faster. Data center fit-out and federal contract award trackers come next.

LOS ALTOS, Calif., Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kapwork today introduced Kapwork Growth Suite, a free platform that helps small businesses find relevant infrastructure work and access capital to grow. The suite brings together data from 80 plus federal departments and agencies. It sits alongside Kapwork's free invoice certification, which verifies money a business is owed so it can be matched with credit providers and funded faster. Any US business can join today at kapwork.com/grow.

The AI buildout needs more than GPUs, it needs the businesses that build America's network: fiber connections, electrical systems, cooling and the contractors who install them. Alongside private investment in AI infrastructure, federal funding is expanding broadband networks. For telecom providers, fiber crews and specialist contractors, the challenge is knowing which projects to pursue, and how to pay for growth.

See where infrastructure money is going

The suite is built around the questions a business owner needs answered. It launches with the BEAD tracker; two more trackers follow:

  • BEAD Awards — Who received funding to build broadband? The Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment program is a $42.45 billion federal initiative to expand high-speed internet access. Kapwork's live tracker helps businesses research award recipients. A fiber contractor can use that information to decide which operators to approach before committing a crew.
  • Data Center Fit-Outs — Which projects are moving beyond an announcement? Coming next: a tracker that organizes fit-outs by location, operator, and reported stage: proposed, under construction, operating, cancelled, or suspended.
  • Federal Contract Awards — Which prime contractors are winning work? Also coming: a tool that will organize more than 50 million federal award actions to help small businesses find federal work.

Kapwork's BEAD tracker covers $11.46 billion in announced awards as of September 16 and adds new awards as states announce them.

"The businesses that build America's network have a cashflow problem. Unless we solve it, we can't build at the speed the country needs to stay competitive," said Mauricio Vergara, co-founder and CEO at Kapwork. "Our goal is to help small businesses grow by providing free tools to understand where the market is going, see who's getting the work, and access working capital."

Turn unpaid invoices into growth capital

A new job can create costs before it generates cash. Contractors need to pay crews and buy materials while invoices for earlier work remain unpaid. Kapwork certifies those receivables and helps the business get funded faster, at better rates.

Once a business sends out an invoice, by email or through a vendor portal, Kapwork proves the invoice exists with the customer who owes it. Kapwork's AI agents verify invoice amounts, approval status and payment terms at the debtor's source turning self pledged paper into certified receivables that a credit provider can evaluate.

""Fabricating invoices is the fraud risk everyone in this space is watching for right now. Pulling from the debtor's own portal cuts that off at the source. Kapwork's certified data gives us the confidence to deploy capital faster and price deals without carrying that doubt in the rate." said Saul Gewer, Chief Strategy Officer, TowerCap. 

Kapwork then matches the business with participating capital providers, including banks, factoring companies and private credit funds that prefer issuing credit against certified invoices. The business reviews available offers and decides whether to accept. The Growth Suite, Invoice Certification and credit matching are free for businesses.

"In Brazil we processed more than US$1 trillion in receivables. As a result, credit supply to SME's more than tripled, with an average cost of credit 75 percent lower than the cost observed before we began operations. Once an invoice is verified, it can't be pledged twice, so funders trust what they're financing, and credit reaches companies that never had it before," said Marcelo Maziero, co-founder of CERC, the Brazilian financial market infrastructure and an investor in Kapwork.

Businesses can join and explore Kapwork Growth Suite today at kapwork.com/grow.

About Kapwork

Kapwork is an AI-native platform helping small businesses find growth opportunities, certify receivables and get matched with capital providers. The company has certified over half a billion dollars in receivables, most of that coming from telecom and datacenter providers. Backed by SaaSholic, Kapwork is also a member of NVIDIA's Inception, a program supporting innovative AI startups.

Kapwork was founded by Pete Thomas and Mauricio Vergara. Thomas helped build C2FO, the working capital platform with half a trillion dollars in receivables flowing through it. Vergara, CEO, saw how "third party" developers at Google struggled with cashflow. Learn more at kapwork.com.

GARLAND, Texas, Sept. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Massimo Group (NASDAQ: MAMO) ("Massimo" or the "Company"), a manufacturer and distributor of powersports and recreational vehicles, today announced the launch of its new Massimo Mini Truck, a retro-inspired two-passenger recreational go-kart developed exclusively for Tractor Supply Company for the 2026 holiday season.

The Mini Truck builds on the success of Massimo's popular Mini 125 platform, introducing a completely refreshed truck-inspired design while retaining the approachable size, performance and recreational appeal that have made the category an important part of Massimo's seasonal product lineup.

"The Holiday Season is very important for this category, and we wanted to give Tractor Supply customers something that feels new, fun and immediately recognizable," said Quenton Petersen, Chief Executive Officer of Massimo Group. "The Mini Truck takes a proven product concept and gives it a completely different personality. It is a great example of how we can continue refreshing successful products and creating unique items specifically for our retail partners."

Powered by a 125cc four-stroke engine, the Mini Truck features a three-speed transmission with reverse, upgraded digital display, two individual seats with an adjustable driver's seat, and LED lighting throughout, including rear lighting.

Designed for riders ages 16 and older, the Mini Truck combines classic compact-truck styling with the accessibility and fun of Massimo's recreational go-kart lineup.

"The go-kart category continues to be an important part of our recreational business," Petersen added. "Our focus is to keep that lineup fresh with products that stand out on the retail floor and give customers another reason to engage with the Massimo brand."

releases.body:
Partnership advances Monumental Sports & Entertainment's vision for technology-forward Capital One Arena powered by industry-leading LG display technology

 All-new 'LG Collective' to debut this season as a dynamic new gathering space and seating destination

WASHINGTON, Sept. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Monumental Sports & Entertainment (MSE) today announced a new long-term partnership naming LG Electronics USA the Official TV, Commercial Display and Appliance Partner of the reimagined Capital One Arena in downtown Washington, D.C. The partnership, aligned with ANC, will bring LG's Direct View LED display technology throughout the transformed venue, delivering true-to-life visual experiences for fans while supporting the arena's next generation of entertainment, operations and hospitality.

Under the multi-year partnership, LG will power the arena's most visible and impactful display experiences, including new exterior LED displays, interior LED and television displays throughout the venue, digital displays across the arena's new business and conference center, and the innovative new "Visibowl" digital display.

A Fast Company Innovation by Design Award finalist, the new LG-powered Visibowl at Capital One Arena will reimagine how fans experience live events by replacing traditional concourse walls with more than 500 feet of immersive digital displays, allowing fans to stay connected to the action as they move throughout the arena. Together, these technologies will create dynamic storytelling opportunities, real-time content, and engaging experiences for the millions of fans who visit Capital One Arena each year.

"The New Capital One Arena is undergoing the most significant transformation in its history, with technology playing a central role in redefining the fan experience," said Jim Van Stone, MSE President of Business Operations and Chief Commercial Officer. "LG's industry-leading innovation and commitment to delivering exceptional visual experiences make them an ideal partner as we build a venue that sets a new standard for sports and entertainment in our nation's capital."

The MSE partnership with LG Electronics includes the "LG Collective"—a new premium seating destination for Washington Wizards, Washington Capitals games and select Capital One Arena events debuting at the start of the 2026–27 season—which will become a featured gathering place at the transformed Capital One Arena. Located on the arena's District Level (former 100 Level), the LG Collective is designed to bring fans and season ticket holders together before, during and after events with views into the bowl and seats connected to the space. The destination will combine an upscale lounge and bar, with all-inclusive food and beverage offerings and integrated club seating with a variety of industry-leading LG innovations creating a dynamic seating experience.

"By partnering with Monumental Sports & Entertainment and ANC, LG is helping to shape the next era of the fan experience in the Nation's Capital," said Don Kwack, President and CEO, LG Electronics North America. "Our collaborations with Capital One Arena and other top venues nationwide demonstrate how LG display technology can elevate virtually every touchpoint in an arena. Through this partnership, concertgoers and fans of the Capitals, Wizards, and Mystics will enjoy a unique, connected experience—led by the incredible new Capital One Arena Visibowl powered by LG display technology."

ANC, a longtime leader in venue technology integration, will oversee the integration, implementation and ongoing service of the new display systems throughout the arena, ensuring seamless performance across every fan touchpoint.

"Capital One Arena's dramatic transformation showcases what can be achieved when great partners come together with a shared commitment to innovation," said ANC President and CEO Jerry N. Cifarelli. "LG's technology platform, paired with ANC's best-in-class integration and game-day content expertise, will deliver sports fans and concert goers a dynamic digital experience across every level of the venue."

The partnership supports MSE's broader vision for the modernization of Capital One Arena—with Phase Two of construction nearly complete—which includes significant investments in technology, enhanced hospitality and fan engagement. The new LED infrastructure will provide enhanced opportunities for live event presentation, sponsorship integration, wayfinding and immersive storytelling throughout the venue.

Rooted in the nation's capital, MSE brings Washington, D.C.'s distinct influence, ambition, and leadership to the global sports and entertainment landscape. The company harnesses the power of its platform to drive continuous innovation and deliver extraordinary experiences that inspire and unite our community, our fans, and our people. For additional information on MSE, please visit monumentalsports.com.

LG Electronics USA Inc., based in Englewood Cliffs, N.J., is the North American subsidiary of LG Electronics Inc., a smart life solutions company with annual global revenues of more than $60 billion. In the United States, LG sells a wide range of innovative home appliances, home entertainment products, commercial displays, air conditioning systems and vehicle components. LG is an 11-time ENERGY STAR® Partner of the Year. www.LG.com.

releases.title: Palmetto Publishing Releases George Kerpi's Debut Crime Novel About a Cold Case That Refuses to Stay Buried
releases.body:
Treacherous Path, a newly published police procedural set in a small mountain town, explores the moral cost of silence through a dual timeline investigation spanning more than a decade.

CHARLESTON, S.C., Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Palmetto Publishing has released Treacherous Path, the debut novel from author George Kerpi. The police procedural follows a detective in the mountain town of Oak Ridge as a gruesome discovery unravels the accepted story of a woman's disappearance and exposes layers of complicity that stretch far beyond a single crime.

The novel opens when a hunting party walks into the Oak Ridge sheriff's office carrying a severed finger bearing a gold ring. Detective Aaron Chase identifies it as belonging to Dr. Natalie Brooks, a physician who had said her goodbyes three days earlier and driven away from the mountain resort where she had worked for four years. Everyone believed she had simply moved on. Chase and his partner begin pulling at the threads of her disappearance, encountering an unsent letter, an ex-husband who surfaced the day she vanished, and a geologist carrying a debt he could neither repay nor acknowledge.

What initially appears to be a crime of passion reveals ties to something far more organized, patient, and dangerous. The investigation builds toward an arrest, a confession, and a verdict the community accepts. But the ground beneath that resolution is unstable. Eleven years later, a woman arrives in Oak Ridge with a cold case file, determined to find out how much was left buried. The dual timeline structure forces questions about institutional failure, personal complicity, and whether the people closest to the truth chose not to see it.

Treacherous Path enters a crime fiction landscape shaped by the atmospheric, character-driven work of authors such as Tana French and Jane Harper. The novel is positioned for readers aged thirty to sixty who gravitate toward procedurals set in insular communities where moral ambiguity matters more than plot twists. Its focus on silence, complicity, and the cost of looking away speaks directly to a cultural moment in which questions about institutional accountability remain urgent and unresolved.

Treacherous Path is available for purchase online at Amazon.com and BarnesandNoble.com. For more information about the author, please visit any of their social media platforms.

Facebook: George Kerpi - Author

Instagram: georgekerpiauthor

About the Author: George Kerpi brings firsthand insight into the world of law and justice to his crime fiction. Raised in a household of government lawyers who held institutions accountable for their actions, he was immersed in questions of right and wrong, legality and lawlessness, long before he could fully understand them. That foundation gives his writing an authenticity that readers can feel on every page.

Kerpi's debut novel, Treacherous Path, was born from a desire to explore crime fiction that resists easy moral categories. Drawn to stories where characters cannot be defined simply as good or bad, he set out to write a mystery that is equal parts dark suspense and human drama. The result is a novel about a violent crime that unravels into something far more complex: a crime of passion entangled with betrayal, organized crime, and the slow erosion of humanity. For Kerpi, the story is not merely imagined; it is a genuine, immersive, reflective experience meant to challenge readers and stay with them long after the final page.

When he is not writing, Kerpi draws inspiration from the tension between the ordinary and the extraordinary in everyday life. He believes that childhood and environment leave a tremendous mark on character, and that belief fuels his commitment to crafting layered, psychologically rich fiction. Follow George for updates on new releases.

releases.title: Factor4 Announces Strategic Partnership with Shopley
releases.body:
BROOMALL, Pa., Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Shopley Inc. (the "Company" or "Shopley"), a consolidated commerce provider of operational and engagement solutions for merchants and merchant services providers, is pleased to announce they have signed an exclusive reseller agreement with Factor4 LLC ("Factor4"), a leading provider of omnichannel gift card and loyalty solutions.

With this new partnership Shopley will become an exclusive reseller of Factor4's gift card and loyalty solution in Canada, integrating their platform and enhancing it with Shopley's operational and engagement solutions. Factor4 gains a localized partner with deep expertise and relationships in the Canadian market plus a plan to better support the French and English market as part of the combined operational and technology plan. Shopley gains a stable and proven gift card solution to integrate with their advanced loyalty engine to take advantage of the constantly changing industry and growing needs of merchants and merchant services providers.

"We are excited to join forces with Factor4 to scale our business further," said Steve Levely, CEO of Shopley. "I joined Factor4 as an advisor in the fall of 2025 after selling my previous company Ackroo. Shortly after joining, I invested in and became CEO of Shopley where Dan and I began exploring how the two companies could work together to scale our respective businesses. We first explored working as complimentary solutions but with the many changes that have happened in the Canadian gift card and loyalty market, we decided Shopley becoming a formal reseller and us building a combined operational and technology solution was best. I am truly excited for how this partnership will transform our business and expect big success for both of our companies."

"Our team is thrilled to partner with Steve and the Shopley team," said Dan Battista, CEO of Factor4. "A lot of Factor4's success has come through the many great partnerships we have formed so to be able to work with someone like Steve who has already been assisting us in various ways is great. Steve and his team have great relationships and understanding of the Canadian market so in an effort to support him and to better expand our business we see this partnership model as the perfect fit."

About Shopley

Founded in 2021, Shopley is a consolidated commerce provider helping brick & mortar and click & mortar merchants from the palm of their hands. From digital signage to niche point-of-sale software solutions and more, Shopley provides a shopping cart of operational and engagement solutions for merchants of all sizes. Shopley is Headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. For more information, visit: www.shopley.com.

About Factor4

Factor4 provides comprehensive gift card and loyalty solutions designed to help merchants increase sales, strengthen customer relationships, and grow their brands through physical and digital gift card programs. Factor4's RewardOS API enables integrations with point-of-sale systems, e-commerce websites, payment terminals, tablets, and other platforms, providing merchants with flexible solutions for managing gift card and loyalty programs across multiple sales channels. Factor4 LLC is Headquartered in Broomall, PA, USA. For more information, visit: www.factor4gift.com.

releases.title: Amuze Acquires Sweet Attractions, Strengthening California Operations and Family Entertainment Capabilities
releases.body:
Acquisition brings together local customer relationships, regional service expertise and national equipment and merchandise resources

AUSTIN, Texas, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Amuze, a national amusement equipment and route-services platform, today announced the acquisition of the operations of Sweet Attractions, a California-based amusement operator serving family entertainment centers, restaurants, bars and other entertainment venues. The transaction also brings affiliated Paramount Amusement Group operations into Amuze. Financial terms were not disclosed.

Sweet Attractions provides equipment installation, operation and ongoing service across arcade games, cranes, redemption attractions and photo booths. The business is growing throughout California and expanding into markets outside the state.

Amuze plans to build its coordinated California operations around a Fresno-based hub while maintaining local field-service coverage. Integration will prioritize customer and employee continuity, shared resources and support for Sweet Attractions' expansion.

Amuze's vertically integrated platform includes Pipeline Games, which designs and manufactures redemption, crane and merchandiser games, and Quality Plush, a supplier of licensed and generic plush merchandise. These businesses will provide Sweet Attractions with equipment, plush and merchandising support, helping venues deliver engaging entertainment experiences.

"Sweet Attractions has always been about taking care of our customers and finding the right entertainment mix for each location," said Mark Knepper, President of Sweet Attractions. "Joining Amuze gives us more equipment choices and deeper service support while preserving the relationships and personal attention our customers value."

"Sweet Attractions is a strong fit with our broader California growth plans," said Stephen Lahti, co-CEO, Finance + M&A. "Mark and his team bring valuable customer relationships, hands-on operating knowledge and a commitment to service. Bringing those strengths together with Amuze's equipment, sourcing and regional support capabilities will help us serve customers more effectively and grow with them."

Knepper will continue working with the business, supporting customer relationships, the team's transition and continued growth.

About Amuze

Amuze combines venue-based entertainment operations with equipment development, sourcing and distribution.

About Sweet Attractions

Sweet Attractions installs, operates and services amusement equipment for family entertainment centers, restaurants, bars and other venues.

From six-camera Hawk-Eye electronic line calling and AI-powered auto-directing to the debut of a voice-interactive smart ball machine, the company is advancing a cost-effective approach to inclusive sports technology, bridging the gap between professional competition and mass participation to "make sports simple."
releases.title: Electronic Line Calling and AI Broadcasting Make CIFTIS Debut: Orange Lion Sports' Smartshot 2.0 Presents an Inclusive "Sports + AI" Solution
releases.body:
BEIJING, Sept. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Orange Lion Sports, founded by Alibaba Group, has unveiled Smartshot 2.0, the upgraded version of its AI sports solution, at the Sports Services exhibition during the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS), held September 9-13 in Beijing.

From six-camera Hawk-Eye electronic line calling and AI-powered auto-directing to the debut of a voice-interactive smart ball machine, the company is advancing a cost-effective approach to inclusive sports technology, bridging the gap between professional competition and mass participation to "make sports simple."

At CIFTIS 2026, Orange Lion Sports' replica tennis court became a focal point. Smartshot 2.0 introduced an upgraded electronic line calling system designed to address long-standing disputes over line calls at amateur tennis events. As soon as the ball lands, a large screen provides instant in/out calls and can announce "IN/OUT" at adjustable volumes. The system supports smoother, fairer amateur competitions at a low marginal cost without requiring additional labor.

AI commentary and auto-directing cut broadcasting costs of up to hundreds of thousands of yuan, making high-quality broadcasts more accessible. AI-powered robots are becoming a valuable complement to traditional sports coaching.

In Orange Lion Sports' roadmap, Smartshot will work with the smart ball machine to interact with trainees through natural language, instantly adjusting ball settings, placement and speed to create personalized training programs and help beginners improve more efficiently.

Leveraging Alibaba's technology capabilities, Smartshot has integrated the Tongyi Qwen large language model to launch what it describes as the industry's first "AI Tournament Assistant" in the first half of 2026. The assistant understands natural-language instructions and parses PDF regulations, enabling scheduling and registration to be completed in minutes. Smartshot now offers pricing at one-tenth that of comparable offerings.

"Our goal is to find the optimal balance between precision and cost control, consistent with our long-standing technical philosophy. We reject expensive professional premiums and pursue cost-effective, inclusive technology," said Peng Wei, CTO of Orange Lion Sports.

releases.title: Reins launches Valuation to help contractors know and grow their business value
releases.body:
New product connects business worth with incentives that help retain the people driving growth

LAS VEGAS, Sept. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Reins, which gives contractors the tools to grow what their business is worth and their key people a real stake, announced today the launch of Valuation, a new standalone AI-powered product that gives owner-operators in the trades a clear view of what their company is worth and what they can do to increase that value.

Reins has raised $5.5 million to date from Album, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Torch Capital and Animo Ventures to level the playing field for independent business owners by giving them access to tools traditionally available to larger companies and private equity-backed businesses.

Valuation joins Reins' existing Incentives product, which helps owners create long-term incentives, including phantom stock and stock appreciation rights (SARs), as well as short-term profit-sharing plans that give key employees a real stake in the value they help create.

Reins initially developed this technology to support Incentives but saw a broader need among contractors for greater visibility into their companies' value. Valuation uses carefully developed AI agents to analyze financial and operating data, deliver a current valuation, identify the factors driving it and pinpoint opportunities for improvement.

Valuation gives owners:

  • A clear number for what the business is worth today, built from the owner's own financial and operating data, including QuickBooks and ServiceTitan data.
  • Visibility into what is holding that number back and how the business compares with peers.
  • Guidance on what to do next, including the incentive plans, KPIs and targets that can help move the business forward.

"Independent business owners spend years building companies that support their families, their employees and their communities, but they haven't always had access to the same sophisticated tools larger companies use to understand and grow their value," said Chris Buttenham, co-founder and CEO of Reins. "We want to change that. Valuation gives owners a clear picture of what they have built, shows them where they can create more value and connects that insight to Incentives so they can give key people a real stake in helping the business grow."

Valuation begins with the owner's own books and operating data to establish what the company is worth today. Its agentic analysis then identifies the factors driving that value, benchmarks the business against peers and highlights the levers with the greatest potential impact. Owners can then use Incentives to align key employees with the KPIs and targets that matter most through long- or short-term plans tied to the value they help create.

"Big companies have a CFO, an appraiser and a compensation consultant a phone call away," Buttenham said. "The owner of a 30-person HVAC shop has none of that: no real number on the business, no plan for what comes next. Valuation is how we level that. It gives independent owners the leverage private equity and big corporations have had for decades."

Valuation and Incentives run on the same data and are designed to work in the background of the business an owner already operates, without adding administrative burden or requiring a consultant. Together, they help contractors understand what their business is worth, act on the factors that can increase that value and build a stronger company with more options when the time comes to sell, hand off or step back on their terms.

For more information about Reins, visit myreins.com.

About Reins

Reins is the ownership operating system for independent businesses, giving owners the tools to understand and grow their business value while giving key employees a real stake in the value they help create. Through Valuation and Incentives, Reins helps owners understand what their business is worth, identify opportunities to increase its value and create long- and short-term incentive plans without giving up ownership or control. Reins works with hundreds of owner-operators in the trades, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, restoration and landscaping, who have granted more than $50 million in incentives to key employees through Reins. Headquartered in Las Vegas, Reins is backed by Album, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Torch Capital and Animo Ventures.. Learn more at myreins.com.

releases.title: MAJOR LEAGUE TABLE TENNIS ANNOUNCES LEAGUE'S MOST EXPANSIVE MEDIA DISTRIBUTION LINEUP
releases.body:
Every Season Four match will stream live on MLTT's YouTube channel and DAZN, with select matches airing on SI TV and expanded national and regional coverage

PRINCETON, N.J., Sept. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Major League Table Tennis (MLTT), the first professional table tennis league in the United States, today announced its most expansive media distribution lineup for the 2026-27 season, bringing every match live to fans through global streaming and extending selected-match and recap programming across free ad-supported streaming television, national cable, regional cable and local broadcast television.

Every MLTT match will stream live on the league's YouTube channel and DAZN throughout the 2026-27 season, which begins Sept. 11. DAZN will also make every match available on demand across its global footprint of more than 200 countries and territories. Sports Illustrated's SI TV will televise select matches on its free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channel in the United States, while Youku Sports will carry live MLTT matches in China.

Event recap programs will appear nationally on FS1 and AXS TV in the United States and on Game+ across Canada, while Gray Media, NBC Sports Bay Area & California and Angels Broadcast Television will expand MLTT's regional presence across key U.S. markets. The agreements mark the first time MLTT has secured third-party media distribution outside the United States, including live match distribution in China through Youku Sports, as well as the league's first regional recap coverage across key U.S. markets.

"In 2023, MLTT was just an idea on a blank sheet of paper. In just a few years, we've built a professional league from the ground up with a wildly engaging format that fans love and media partners increasingly want to be part of," said Flint Lane, Founder and CEO of Major League Table Tennis. "The demand for MLTT content is a great validation of the quality and excitement of our competition. We couldn't be prouder of how far we've come, and we're even more excited about where we're going. Season four will bring MLTT to more fans, on more platforms, than ever before."

The expanded distribution lineup also provides a broader national and international platform for MLTT's teams, athletes and commercial partners as the league enters its fourth season.

MLTT enters its fourth season with accelerating momentum after generating more than 76 million video views during the 2025-26 season and concluding the campaign with a sold-out Championship Weekend.

MLTT'S 2026-27 MEDIA DISTRIBUTION LINEUP

LIVE AND SELECTED MATCH COVERAGE

MLTT YouTube: Every MLTT match will stream live and free on the league's YouTube channel, with full replays and highlights available on demand.

DAZN: Every MLTT match will stream live and be available on demand across more than 200 countries and territories.

SI TV: Select MLTT matches will air on the network's free U.S. FAST channel.

Youku Sports: Live MLTT matches will be available in China.

UNITED STATES AND CANADA RECAP PROGRAMMING

FS1: Two 30-minute national recap specials will air during the 2026-27 season in the United States.

AXS TV: A slate of 16 one-hour recap shows will air nationally in the United States.

Game+: A slate of 16 one-hour recap shows will air across Canada.

REGIONAL RECAP PROGRAMMING

Gray Media: 16 one-hour recap shows will air across select Gray Media markets in Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Minnesota, Ohio, South Carolina and Tennessee.

NBC Sports Bay Area & California: 16 one-hour recap shows will be distributed across Northern California, Nevada and Oregon.

Angels Broadcast Television (ABTV): 16 one-hour recap shows will be distributed across Southern California, Nevada and Hawaii.

"Our media distribution strategy is built around the multiple ways fans discover and follow sports today," said Matt Parker, Senior Vice President, Marketing for Major League Table Tennis. "Every match will be available live on YouTube and DAZN. SI TV will bring select MLTT matches to its U.S. audience, Youku Sports will expand live access in China, national recap programming will introduce MLTT to new audiences, and regional outlets will connect our teams to local fans. Together, these platforms create a strong path from initial exposure to lasting fandom."

Additional broadcast schedules, air times, platform availability and local listings will be announced separately.

MLTT was advised by Range Sports on its 2026-27 media distribution agreements.

ABOUT MAJOR LEAGUE TABLE TENNIS

Major League Table Tennis is the first professional table tennis league in the United States, featuring world-class athletes competing in a fast-paced, city-based team format. Founded in 2023, MLTT is dedicated to growing participation, building fandom and establishing table tennis as a major professional sport in North America. For more information, visit MLTT.com.

Key Takeaways 

  • Melissa Rivers will return to the red carpet for the first time in nearly two decades, joining CNN and Variety for live coverage of the 78th Emmy Awards on Monday, September 14.  



  • The fashion expert, host and author will join CNN Correspondent Elizabeth Wagmeister and Variety co-president and co-editor-in-chief Ramin Setoodeh throughout CNN & Variety Red Carpet Live: TV's Biggest Night, bringing her signature wit and expert eye to the evening's fashion, trends and standout moments.  



  • The return marks a full-circle career moment for Rivers, who helped shape modern red-carpet coverage alongside her mother, Joan Rivers, and now returns to the carpet in a new chapter of her own.  

LOS ANGELES, Sept. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Melissa Rivers is returning to where she and her mother were the first ones to turn walking into a building as an event. They helped change the conversation around celebrity fashion, pop culture, and entertainment. For the first time in nearly 20 years, the entertainment host and fashion expert will be back on the red carpet, joining CNN and Variety for live coverage of the 78th Emmy Awards on Monday, September 14.

Rivers will join CNN Correspondent Elizabeth Wagmeister and Variety co-president and co-editor-in-chief Ramin Setoodeh throughout CNN & Variety Red Carpet Live: TV's Biggest Night, offering her signature wit, sharp perspective and expert eye on the fashion trends and the moments everyone will be talking about the next day. The special begins at 5 p.m. ET and will stream live at //CNN.com/Watch and on the CNN app for CNN's streaming subscribers. 

"It's a little surreal to think that I'm returning to the red carpet nearly 20 years later," said Melissa Rivers. "I'm excited to be back on the red carpet with CNN and Variety, but to be honest, I'm slightly terrified. Fashion has changed, the red carpet has changed, and I've definitely changed. In my opinion, red carpets have gotten a little too serious over the last few years and I hope to bring some of that fun back."

Q&A for Context 

Why is Melissa Rivers' return to the red carpet significant?

Melissa Rivers became a fixture of awards-season coverage alongside her mother, Joan Rivers, helping bring candid fashion commentary, humor and personality to the red carpet. Her return to the Emmys marks her first time back on the carpet in nearly two decades and a new chapter for Rivers.

What will Melissa Rivers do during CNN and Variety's Emmy coverage? 

Rivers will join Wagmeister and Setoodeh throughout the evening, bringing her perspective to the red-carpet fashion, emerging trends and memorable moments from television's biggest night. Wagmeister and Setoodeh will host the live special, featuring commentary and interviews with the stars and creators behind some of the year's most celebrated television. 

How can audiences watch? 

CNN & Variety Red Carpet Live: TV's Biggest Night will stream live Monday, September 14 beginning at 5 p.m. ET for CNN's streaming and pay TV subscribers via CNN.com, CNN connected TV and mobile apps. CNN subscribers will be able to access additional Emmys content on the CNN app. 

Why is CNN and Variety teaming up for the Emmys? 

The Emmy red-carpet special is the first major activation of CNN and Variety's expanded partnership, combining CNN's global reach and multiplatform audience with Variety's entertainment industry access and expertise.  

About Melissa Rivers 

Melissa Rivers is an award-winning television host, producer, New York Times bestselling author and fashion expert whose career spans decades across entertainment, pop culture and red-carpet coverage. A longtime television personality and commentator, Rivers has built a distinct voice known for her candid humor, sharp perspective and deep knowledge of fashion and entertainment. She continues to appear across national television, digital media and podcasts as a sought-after voice on fashion, pop culture and the entertainment industry.

releases.body:
New health and life sciences practice debuts AdherenceIQ, an AI-powered platform that predicts patient adherence risk

ATLANTA, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Medication nonadherence costs the U.S. healthcare system as much as $300 billion annually. Despite significant investments in awareness, patient acquisition, and new prescription generation, life sciences companies struggle to identify which patients will start/discontinue therapy and understand the emotional barriers driving those decisions.

Response Media launches health and life sciences practice to address pharma's $300 billion adherence blind spot

Response Media today announced the launch of RE: HEALTH, a specialized health and life sciences practice built to help pharmaceutical and health brands close that gap.

Backed by decades of healthcare marketing expertise, RE: HEALTH combines behavioral science, privacy-compliant AI and advanced analytics to help brands identify the emotional barriers to treatment and translate that intelligence into engagement strategies that improve adherence, persistence and TRx growth.

"Medicine is an emotional decision but the industry has marketed it as a functional one," said Josh Perlstein, Response Media CEO. "We believe there is a smarter approach, and it begins with focusing on the human behind every treatment."

With the launch, the company is introducing AdherenceIQ, a proprietary, AI-powered behavioral intelligence platform that predicts and addresses therapy adherence risk before drop-off occurs.

Built on published adherence science, AdherenceIQ identifies the emotional and functional barriers preventing patients from starting or continuing therapy, predicts who is most likely to disengage and why, and recommends intervention strategies based on those barriers.

For chronic and rare disease therapies, where adherence and persistence are critical to patient outcomes and commercial performance, AdherenceIQ shifts the focus from measuring attrition to identifying patients at risk of disengaging while there is still an opportunity to intervene.

"Adherence is too often treated as a reminder problem," said Dr. Alvin Glay, chief strategy officer, RE:HEALTH. "But patients don't make decisions based on reminders. Concerns about side effects, necessity, distrust, and stigma all shape their decisions. We can now uncover those barriers early enough to intervene in a relevant, human way that not only improves patient outcomes but accelerates TRx growth."

About Response Media: Ad Age's Data & Insights Small Agency of the Year in 2025, Response Media is a performance marketing agency specializing in data-led CRM/CX strategy and media. The agency has worked with a range of healthcare brands including Bausch + Lomb, Mucinex, Enfamil, and WellStreet Urgent Care.

releases.body:
New Fullerton facility extends same-day quoting and fast turnarounds to Los Angeles, the Inland Empire, North San Diego County, and the Bay Area

FULLERTON, Calif., Sept. 10, 2026 /CNW/ -- Blast Media Print (Blast Media Inc.), a large-format printing and visual branding company founded in Vancouver, BC, has opened a new production location in Orange County, California. The facility gives Southern California businesses direct, local access to the same large-format print capabilities Blast Media has built its reputation on: banners, retail signage, window and wall graphics, vehicle wraps, UV direct printing, trade show displays and more.

The new location is positioned to serve the region's busiest commercial markets, including Los Angeles, Orange County's retail and corporate corridors around South Coast Plaza and Irvine, the Anaheim Resort district, and the medical corridor in the City of Orange. It also extends coverage to the Inland Empire, North San Diego County, and -- with the same turnaround standards -- the San Francisco Bay Area.

"Southern California has been one of our fastest-growing markets, and it made sense to put a team and a facility on the ground here rather than keep shipping everything down from Vancouver," said Allan Louie, CEO and Founder of Blast Media Print. "This location lets us give Orange County and the surrounding region the same fast turnarounds and hands-on production our clients already count on."

"This isn't just a new address for us," said Quinn Louie, Owner and Director of Operations. "It's us telling clients in Southern California -- and across the U.S. -- that we're always finding new ways to serve them better. That's what this location is all about." said Quinn Louie, Owner and Director of Operations.

Built for Fast Turnarounds Across the Region

The Orange County location runs on equipment built for oversized runs, with most clients receiving a same-day quote and standard large-format jobs turned around in days rather than weeks. Delivery and installation are available throughout California, including Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Jose, Oakland, San Diego, Long Beach, Fullerton, Anaheim, Santa Ana, Irvine, Huntington Beach, Costa Mesa, Orange, Garden Grove, Newport Beach, Mission Viejo, Fountain Valley, Brea, Yorba Linda, Tustin, Cerritos, Buena Park, and Corona.

WASHINGTON, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Broadcasters controlled by terrorist-designated organizations Hezbollah, Hamas, the Houthis and Kata'ib Hezbollah - collectively responsible for the deaths of hundreds of Americans - are being distributed to American households through illicit piracy streaming services, packaged alongside movies and live sports, according to an investigation by the Digital Citizens Alliance (DCA) and cybersecurity firm risk3sixty.
releases.title: U.S.-Sanctioned Terrorist Broadcasters Distributed on Piracy Platforms Reaching American Homes, Investigation Finds
releases.body:
Digital Citizens Alliance and risk3sixty find Hezbollah's Al-Manar, a U.S.-designated terrorist entity, bundled alongside movies and live sports on 17 of 25 illicit streaming services tested

WASHINGTON, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Broadcasters controlled by terrorist-designated organizations Hezbollah, Hamas, the Houthis and Kata'ib Hezbollah - collectively responsible for the deaths of hundreds of Americans - are being distributed to American households through illicit piracy streaming services, packaged alongside movies and live sports, according to an investigation by the Digital Citizens Alliance (DCA) and cybersecurity firm risk3sixty.

Researchers found broadcasters affiliated with designated terrorist organizations or sanctioned foreign states on 17 of the 25 piracy platforms it examined. All were accessible over U.S. Internet connections. Al-Manar, Hezbollah's official broadcaster, was most prevalent, appearing on all 17 services carrying such programming. The State Department placed Al-Manar on the State Department's Terrorist Exclusion List in 2004 and the Treasury Department designated it as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist entity in March 2006.

The findings appear in a new report, Hostile Signals: How Illicit Piracy Platforms Give Terrorist-Controlled and Sanctioned Foreign Broadcasters Access to American Homes.

The joint investigation documents how piracy platforms provide organizations associated with terrorist organizations or other U.S. adversaries a commercial distribution system, operating outside U.S. law, that grants them access to paying American subscribers who never went looking for them. Access to the U.S. market is troubling considering the intelligence community's March 2026 assessment that Islamist terrorist groups have shifted toward information operations intended to spread propaganda and to inspire "lone wolf" attacks by individuals with access to the West.

"Piracy platforms give terrorist organizations a back door to access the U.S. market, circumventing two decades of efforts to keep these organizations from being able to broadcast into American homes," said Tom Galvin, Executive Director of the Digital Citizens Alliance.

"Our investigation found that piracy services routinely package terrorist-controlled broadcasters alongside everyday entertainment, creating a distribution channel that operates outside traditional safeguards. When extremist content is embedded in the same interface as sports, movies, and news, it becomes far less visible to those working to identify and disrupt radicalization efforts," said Steven Guris, threat intelligence lead at risk3sixty.

In the report, Digital Citizens and risk3sixty make three recommendations to lawmakers and law enforcement to address this national security threat:

  • Site-blocking Legislation. Site-blocking is a legal process to block access from the United States to foreign websites. While it's generally designed to combat infringers, it could address the problem of terrorist-linked broadcasters being distributed through piracy services by disrupting the piracy networks that carry their content. Legislation before Congress proposes a judicially supervised remedy aimed only at large-scale foreign piracy operations. While copyright owners drive the petition process, if the result is blocking piracy sites that carry the outlets of terrorist organizations, then site-blocking provides a national security benefit.



    In a September 2026 research survey of over 1,000 Americans, 65 percent supported allowing courts to order Internet providers to block access to foreign websites that distribute pirated content. Only 10 percent were opposed.
  • Treasury Sanctions Advisory. Treasury regularly issues sector-specific advisories alerting industries to sanctions exposure. An advisory directed at piracy operators, resellers, and the payment processors and hosting providers that serve them would put the industry on notice that carriage of Specially Designated Global Terrorist-owned broadcasters creates sanctions exposure.



  • Justice Department Domain Seizures. DOJ has seized domains for broadcasters owned or controlled by terrorist-designated organizations. Those cases were straightforward: a designated entity cannot obtain U.S. domain services without a Treasury Department license. Piracy platforms are harder. They aren't designated entities, so any case turns on what operators knew and kept carrying. But the predicate now exists - named services, named channels, confirmed U.S. access. DOJ should determine which operators fall within U.S. jurisdiction, put them and their registrars, hosts, and payment processors on formal notice, and seize where carriage continues afterward.

The full report is available at https://hostile-signals.digitalcitizensalliance.org/.

About Digital Citizens Alliance

The Digital Citizens Alliance is a nonprofit, 501(c)(6) organization that is a consumer-oriented coalition focused on educating the public and policymakers on the threats that consumers face on the Internet. Digital Citizens wants to create a dialogue on the importance for Internet stakeholders—individuals, government, and industry—to make the Web a safer place. Based in Washington, DC, the Digital Citizens Alliance counts among its supporters: private citizens, the health, pharmaceutical, and creative industries, as well as online safety experts and other communities focused on Internet safety. Learn more about Digital Citizens Alliance.

About risk3sixty

risk3sixty is an elite boutique cybersecurity firm headquartered in the greater Atlanta area, serving clients nationwide with continuous threat exposure management (CTEM), threat intelligence, and proactive security services through its Armada Proactive Services practice. Unlike software-only exposure management platforms that bury teams in unvalidated alerts, Armada embeds senior practitioners who run continuous threat intelligence, manually exploit findings to prove what's actually dangerous, and stay on every exposure until it's closed for good. In addition, risk3sixty offers a comprehensive suite of services for CISOs, including internal audit, compliance, and GRC program optimization.

Learn more about risk3sixty's proactive services at https://risk3sixty.com/secure

releases.title: FlexFactor Named Finalist in Six Categories at The Card & Payments Awards US 2026
releases.body:
Recognition across six categories highlights FlexFactor's AI-native approach to reversing eligible false declines during authorization

NEW YORK, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FlexFactor, the payments technology company behind AI-native AcceptIQ, has been named a finalist in six categories at The Card & Payments Awards US 2026. Based on FlexFactor's review of the published 2026 shortlist, FlexFactor is the only organization with six finalist selections.

                                               

FlexFactor has been shortlisted for:

  • Best Application of AI or ML in Financial Services
  • Best Customer Service
  • Best Early-Stage or Future Payments Initiative
  • Best Industry Innovation
  • Best Payment Facility
  • Best POS Solution

These six selections span distinct areas of the payments ecosystem – from artificial intelligence and customer experience to future payments, industry innovation, payment infrastructure, and point-of-sale technology.

FlexFactor's Approach – Creating a New Decisioning Layer Inside Payment Authorization

Historically, payment technologies have largely operated on either side of authorization. Fraud, risk, and authentication technologies evaluate transactions before issuer response, while retries, dunning, and account updater solutions attempt recovery after a payment has already failed. FlexFactor created real-time decline decisioning to bridge this structural gap.

At the center of the capability is AcceptIQ, FlexFactor's AI-native platform for real-time payment decline decisioning. AcceptIQ evaluates transaction, issuer, merchant, data-quality, acquiring, and routing signals to determine whether a decline is recoverable, the likelihood of successful reauthorization, and the appropriate recovery path.

When AcceptIQ identifies an eligible false decline, FlexFactor can execute the recovery, purchase the merchant's invoice, guarantee the sale, and assume the recovery risk. This enables eligible false payment declines to be reversed before they become lost sales, wasted customer acquisition spend, lost lifetime value, or damaging customer experiences.

For the end customer, the recovery is invisible. Legitimate customers can complete their intended purchase without retrying the transaction, changing payment methods, or entering a separate recovery journey.

FlexFactor is live with more than 100 merchants and typically cures 15% to 20% of eligible declines across live deployments, with observed results varying by merchant profile, decline mix, and payment environment.

"Reversing a failed payment after it has already been declined by some of the world's most sophisticated payment systems is not a simple problem. Doing it in real time makes it even harder," said Guy Vatman, CTO of FlexFactor. "It requires evaluating multiple signals and determining the right recovery path within the authorization flow before that failed-payment experience reaches the customer. To solve that challenge, we built AcceptIQ, which creates real value for the payments ecosystem – enabling merchants to preserve legitimate sales as customers complete their purchase without even knowing a decline occurred."

A Word From The Card & Payments Awards

"For more than 20 years, The Card & Payments Awards have been about recognizing the organizations and people raising standards across the payments ecosystem. As we bring the Awards to the United States for the first time, the quality and breadth of this year's shortlist demonstrates the extraordinary level of innovation taking place across the industry. Being shortlisted is an achievement in itself. To be recognized across six categories is a significant result for FlexFactor and reflects the breadth of the work presented to our independent judging panel. We look forward to welcoming FlexFactor, alongside our wider finalist community, to Gotham Hall in New York on November 17." – Michael Harty, Founder & Managing Director, The Card & Payments Awards

The Card & Payments Awards US 2026

Established in 2005, The Card & Payments Awards recognizes excellence, innovation, and best practice across the payments industry. In 2026, the Awards bring their independent judging process and industry community to the United States for the inaugural US event.

The winners of The Card & Payments Awards US 2026 will be announced on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at Gotham Hall, New York. The evening begins at 6 pm and continues until late.

Event – The Card & Payments Awards US 2026
Date – November 17, 2026
Venue – Gotham Hall, New York

About FlexFactor

FlexFactor is a payments technology company transforming payment decline recovery through real-time decline decisioning during authorization. Its AI-native AcceptIQ platform identifies, evaluates, and reverses eligible false payment declines before customers experience a failed payment – helping merchants prevent legitimate transactions from becoming lost sales, wasted customer acquisition spend, lost lifetime value, and damaging customer experiences. FlexFactor supports one-time, recurring, and hybrid commerce through existing payment infrastructure, enabling merchants to improve payment performance without adding friction to checkout. FlexFactor is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.

Since 2005, The Card & Payments Awards has recognized excellence and innovation across the global payments ecosystem. The Awards are built around an independent judging process and bring together organizations shaping the future of payments. The inaugural US Awards create a new platform to recognize the companies, technologies, partnerships, and people advancing payments across the United States.

releases.title: Magic EdTech Introduces ezSuite™, an AI-Native Content Solution to Transform Modern Publishing
releases.body:
ezSuite™ helps publishers and institutions move beyond print-first workflows with modular content, AI-enabled productivity, and governed publishing operations.

NEW YORK, Sept. 9, 2026 /CNW/ -- Magic EdTech announced ezSuite™, its AI-native content operations solution designed to address the barriers publishers and institutions face in creating, managing, updating, and delivering content at scale. For organizations navigating fragmented systems and manual workflows, ezSuite™ brings greater speed, control, reuse, and transparency across the content lifecycle.

ezSuite™ replaces traditional, format-locked content production processes with a unified ecosystem. Instead of treating books, assessments, media, and derivative assets as disconnected outputs, ezSuite™ creates a component-based source of truth that supports modular authoring, synchronized updates, and multi-channel publishing.

The solution makes learning assets easier to discover, reuse, and update through structured metadata and version control, supporting personalized and adaptive learning pathways that respond to learner needs.

For edtech, this means faster revision cycles, lower operational friction, and an agile path from content creation to delivery. Once content is modularized, updates to core learning objects can automatically identify related assessments, resources, media, metadata, and supplements for review. This synchronized workflow helps teams maintain accuracy across large portfolios.

ezSuite™ combines AI and automation with strong editorial governance. It follows a human-in-the-loop model where output remains reviewable before release. Full audit trails source inputs, reviewer decisions, and final outputs, maintaining quality, compliance, and academic rigor.

For greater data privacy and ownership, ezSuite™ can be deployed within its own managed infrastructure, with customer content and outputs not used to train foundation models.

"Through ezSuite™, we are fundamentally redefining the content lifecycle, shifting the industry toward a unified, AI-native ecosystem where structured content serves as the single source of truth," said Sanjay Kabra, COO of Magic EdTech. "By integrating agentic AI with rigorous editorial governance, ezSuite™ empowers publishers to transform assets into dynamic, continuously evolving learning experiences that scale effortlessly."

Beyond operational efficiency, ezSuite™ opens new opportunities for portfolio expansion. Publishers can create new product variants, localized editions, adaptive learning experiences, multilingual content, multimedia formats, and personalized learning paths from the same trusted foundation.
